A01006.description: Firmware update for DRIVE-CLiQ component required
A01006.cause:
The firmware of a DRIVE-CLiQ component must be updated as there is no suitable firmware or firmware version in
the component for operation with the Control Unit.
A01006.action:
Firmware update using the commissioning software:
The firmware version of all of the components on the "Version overview" page can be read in the Project Navigator
under "Configuration" of the associated drive unit and an appropriate firmware update can be carried out.
Firmware update via parameter:
- take the component number from the alarm value and enter into p7828.
- start the firmware download with p7829 = 1.

A01007.description: POWER ON for DRIVE-CLiQ component required
A01007.cause: A DRIVE-CLiQ component must be powered up again (POWER ON) (e.g. due to a firmware update).
A01007.action:
- Switch off the power supply of the specified DRIVE-CLiQ component and switch it on again.
- For SINUMERIK, auto commissioning is prevented. In this case, a POWER ON is required for all components and
the auto commissioning must be restarted.
A01007.note: For a component number = 1, a POWER ON of the Control Unit is required.

A01009.cause: The temperature (r0037[0]) of the control module (Control Unit) has exceeded the specified limit value.
A01009.action:
- check the air intake for the Control Unit.
- check the Control Unit fan.
A01009.note: The alarm automatically disappears after the limit value has been undershot.

A01016.cause:
At least one firmware file in the directory was illegally changed on the non-volatile memory (memory card/device
memory) with respect to the version when shipped from the factory.
A01016.action: For the non-volatile memory for the firmware (memory card/device memory), restore the delivery condition.
A01016.note:
The file involved can be read out using parameter r9925.
The status of the firmware check is displayed using r9926.

A01017.cause:
On the memory card, one file in the directory /SIEMENS/SINAMICS/DATA or /ADDON/SINAMICS/DATA has been
illegally changed with respect to that supplied from the factory. No changes are permitted in this directory.
A01017.action: For the file on the memory card involved, restore the status originally supplied from the factory.

A01019.description: Writing to the removable data medium unsuccessful
A01019.cause: The write access to the removable data medium was unsuccessful.
A01019.action: Remove and check the removable data medium. Then run the data backup again.

A01020.cause: A write access to the internal RAM disk was unsuccessful.
A01020.action: Adapt the file size for the system logbook to the internal RAM disk (p9930).

A01021.description: Removable data medium as USB data storage medium from the PC used
A01021.cause:
The removable data medium is used as USB data storage medium from a PC
As a consequence, the drive cannot access the removable data medium. When backing up, the configuration data
cannot be saved on the removable data medium.
A01021.action: Deactivate the USB connection to the PC and back up the configuration data.
A01021.note:
The alarm is automatically canceled when disconnecting the USB connection or when removing the removable data
medium.

A01028.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The parameterization that was downloaded was generated with a different module type (Order No., MLFB).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The "SERVO" control mode has not been released with this firmware.
A01028.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Save parameters in a non-volatile fashion (p0971 = 1).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Use the "VECTOR" control mode.

A01035.cause:
When the Control Unit is booted, no complete data set was found from the parameter back-up files. The last time
that the parameterization was saved, it was not completely carried out.
It is possible that the backup was interrupted by switching off or withdrawing the memory card.
A01035.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- Download the project again with the commissioning software.
- save all parameters (p0971 = 1 or "copy RAM to ROM").

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- Download the project again with the commissioning software.
- save all parameters (p0977 = 1 or "copy RAM to ROM").

A01045.cause:
An error was detected when evaluating the parameter files PSxxxyyy.ACX, PTxxxyyy.ACX, CAxxxyyy.ACX, or
CCxxxyyy.ACX saved in the non-volatile memory. Because of this, under certain circumstances, several of the saved
parameter values were not able to be accepted. Also see r9406 up to r9408.
A01045.action:
- Check the parameters displayed in r9406 up to r9408, and correct these if required.
- Restore the factory setting using (p0970 = 1) and re-load the project into the drive unit.
Then save the parameterization in STARTER using the "Copy RAM to ROM" function or with p0971 = 1. This overwrites the incorrect parameter files in the non-volatile memory – and the alarm is withdrawn.

A01049.description: CU: It is not possible to write to file / It is not possible to write to file
A01049.cause: It is not possible to write into a write-protected file (PSxxxxxx.acx). The write request was interrupted.
A01049.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Check whether the "write protected" attribute has been set for the files in the non-volatile memory under
.../USER/SINAMICS/DATA/... When required, remove write protection and save again (e.g. set p0971 to 1).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Check whether the "write protected" attribute has been set for the files in the non-volatile memory under
.../USER/SINAMICS/DATA/...
When required, remove write protection and save again (e.g. set p0977 to 1).

A01053.cause: A system overload was determined based on measured values.
A01053.action:
- reduce the sampling time.
- only use one data set (CDS, DDS).
- de-activate the function module.
- de-activate drive object.
- remove the drive object from the target topology.

A01064.cause: CRC error in the Control Unit program memory
A01064.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

A01066.description: Buffer memory: 70% f ill level reached or exceeded
A01066.cause:
The non-volatile buffer memory for parameter changes is filled to at least 70%.
This can also occur if the buffer memory is active (p0014 = 1) and parameters are continually changed via a fieldbus
system.
A01066.action:
If required, de-activate and clear the buffer memory (p0014 = 0).
If required, clear the buffer memory (p0014 = 2).
In the following cases, the entries in the buffer memory are transferred into the ROM and then the buffer memory is
cleared:
- p0971 = 1
- power down/power up the Control Unit

A01067.cause:
The non-volatile buffer memory for parameter changes is filled to 100%.
All additional parameter changes will no longer be taken into account in the non-volatile buffer memory. However,
parameter changes can still be made in the volatile memory (RAM).
This can also occur if the buffer memory is active (p0014 = 1) and parameters are continually changed via a fieldbus
system.
A01067.action:
If required, de-activate and clear the buffer memory (p0014 = 0).
If required, clear the buffer memory (p0014 = 2).
In the following cases, the entries in the buffer memory are transferred into the ROM and then the buffer memory is
cleared:
- p0971 = 1
- power down/power up the Control Unit

A01069.cause:
The parameter backup (on memory card or in the drive device) and the drive device and/or its control mode (vector
or servo) do not match.
The module boots with the factory settings.
Example:
Devices A and B. are not compatible and a memory card with the parameter backup for device A is inserted in device
B.
A01069.action:
- insert a memory card with compatible parameter backup and carry out a POWER ON.
- insert a memory card without parameter backup and carry out a POWER ON.
- If required, withdraw the memory card and carry out POWER ON.
- check the control mode that has been set (vector/servo)
- carry out a factory reset to restore factory settings.
- save the parameters (p0971 = 1).

A01073.description: POWER ON required for backup copy on memory card
A01073.cause:
The parameter assignment on the visible partition of the memory card has changed.
In order that the backup copy on the memory card is updated on the non-visible partition, it is necessary to carry out
a POWER ON or hardware reset (p0972) of the Control Unit.
A01073.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for the Control Unit.
- carry out a hardware reset (RESET button, p0972).
A01073.note: It is possible that a new POWER ON is requested via this alarm (e.g. after saving with p0971 = 1).

A01100.cause: The memory card (non-volatile memory) was withdrawn during operation.
A01100.action:
- power down the drive system.
- re-insert the memory card that was withdrawn - this card must match the drive system.
- power up the drive system again.

A01251.cause: Error when reading the read-write data of the EEPROM in the Control Unit.
A01251.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
For alarm value r2124 < 256, the following applies:
- carry out a POWER ON.
- replace the Control Unit.
For alarm value r2124 >= 256, the following applies:
- clear the fault memory (p0952 = 0).
- replace the Control Unit.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
For alarm value r2124 < 256, the following applies:
- carry out a POWER ON.
- replace the Control Unit.
For alarm value r2124 >= 256, the following applies:
- for the drive object with this alarm, clear the fault memory (p0952 = 0).
- as an alternative, clear the fault memory of all drive objects (p2147 = 1).
- replace the Control Unit.

A01256.description: CU: Option Board EEPROM  read-write data error
A01256.cause: Error when reading the read-write data of the EEPROM in the Option Board.
A01256.action:
- carry out a POWER ON.
- replace the Control Unit.

A01304.description: Firmware version of DRI VE-CLiQ component is not up-to-date
A01304.cause: The non-volatile memory has a more recent firmware version than the one in the connected DRIVE-CLiQ component.
A01304.action: Update the firmware (p7828, p7829 and commissioning software).

A01306.description: Firmware of the DRIVE-CLiQ component being updated
A01306.cause: Firmware update is active for at least one DRIVE-CLiQ component.
A01306.action:
Not necessary.
This alarm automatically disappears after the firmware has been updated.

A01314.description: Topology: Component must not be present
A01314.cause: For a component, "de-activate and not present" is set but this component is still in the topology.
A01314.action:
- remove the corresponding component.
- change the setting "de-activate and not present".
A01314.note:
Component class and connection number are described in F01375.
Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

A01315.description: Drive object not ready for operation
A01315.cause: For the active drive object involved, at least one activated component is missing.
A01315.action:
The alarm automatically disappears again with the following actions:
- de-activate the drive object involved (p0105 = 0).
- de-activate the components involved (p0125 = 0, p0145 = 0, p0155 = 0, p0165 = 0).
- re-insert the components involved.
A01315.note: All other active and operational drive objects can be in the "RUN" state.

A01316.description: Drive object inactive and again ready for operation
A01316.cause:
If, when inserting a component of the target topology, an inactive, non-operational drive object becomes operational
again. The associated parameter of the component is, in this case, set to "activate" (p0125, p0145, p0155, p0165).
A01316.action:
The alarm automatically disappears again with the following actions:
- activate the drive object involved (p0105 = 1).
- again withdraw the components involved.
A01316.note: This is the only message that is displayed for a de-activated drive object.

A01317.cause: If a component of the target topology for an active drive object is inserted and the associated parameter of the component is set to "de-activate" (p0125, p0145, p0155, p0165).
A01317.action:
The alarm automatically disappears again with the following actions:
- activate the components involved (p0125 = 1, p0145 = 1, p0155 = 1, p0165 = 1).
- again withdraw the components involved.
A01317.note: This is the only message that is displayed for a de-activated component.

A01318.cause:
This alarm is used in the following cases:
- If an inactive/non-operational drive object is active again/ready for operation
- If there are items in the list of BI/CI parameters (r9498[0...29], r9499[0...29])
- If the BICO interconnections saved in the list of BI/CI parameters (r9498[0...29], r9499[0...29]) have actually been
changed
A01318.action:
Reset alarm:
- Set p9496 to 1 or 2
or
- de-activate the drive object again.

A01319.cause:
Initialization is required for at least one inserted component.
This is only possible if the pulses are inhibited for all the drive objects.
A01319.action: Activate pulse inhibit for all drive objects.

A01320.description: Topology: Drive object number does not exist in configuration
A01320.cause: A drive object number is missing in p0978
A01320.action:
Set p0009 to 1 and change p0978:
Rules:
- p0978 must include all of the drive object numbers (p0101).
- it is not permissible for a drive object number to be repeated.
- by entering a 0, the drive objects with PZD are separated from those without PZD.
- only 2 partial lists are permitted. After the second 0, all values must be 0.
- dummy drive object numbers (255) are only permitted in the first partial list.

A01321.description: Topology: Drive object number does not exist in configuration
A01321.cause: p0978 contains a drive object number that does not exist.
A01321.action:
Set p0009 to 1 and change p0978:

A01322.description: Topology: Drive object number present twice in configuration

A01322.action:
Set parameter p0009 = 1 and change p0978:

A01323.description: Topology: More than two partial lists created
A01323.cause: Partial lists are available more than twice in p0978. After the second 0, all must be 0.
A01323.action:
Set p0009 to 1 and change p0978:
Rules:

- dummy drive object numbers (255) are only permitted in the first partial list.

A01324.description: Topology: Dummy drive object number incorrectly created
A01324.cause: In p0978, dummy drive object numbers (255) are only permitted in the first partial list.
A01324.action:
Set p0009 to 1 and change p0978:
Rules:

A01330.description: Topology: Quick co mmissioning not possible
A01330.cause: Unable to carry out a quick commissioning. The existing actual topology does not fulfill the requirements.
A01330.action:
- adapt the output topology to the permissible requirements.
- carry out commissioning using the commissioning software.
- for motors with DRIVE-CLiQ, connect the power and DRIVE-CLiQ cable to the same Motor Module (Single Motor
Module: DRIVE-CLiQ at X202, Double Motor Module: DRIVE-CLiQ from motor 1 (X1) to X202, from motor 2 (X2) to
X203).
Re aa = 06 hex = 6 dec and bb = 01 hex = 1 dec:
Correct the order number when commissioning using the commissioning software.
A01330.note: Connection type and connection number are described in F01375.

A01331.description: Topology: At least one component not assigned to a drive object
A01331.cause:
At least one component is not assigned to a drive object.
- when commissioning, a component was not able to be automatically assigned to a drive object.
- the parameters for the data sets are not correctly set.
A01331.action:
This component is assigned to a drive object.
Check the parameters for the data sets.
Examples:
- power unit (p0121).
- motor (p0131, p0186).
- encoder interface (p0140, p0141, p0187 ... p0189).
- encoder (p0140, p0142, p0187 ... p0189).
- Terminal Module (p0151).
- option board (p0161).

A01358.cause:
At least one line with distributed drives is not terminated. The last participant on the line must be terminated with a
line termination connector.
This therefore ensures the degree of protection of the distributed drives.
A01358.action: Install the line terminating connector for the last distributed drive.

A01361.description: Topology: Actual topology contains  SINUMERIK and SIMOTION components
A01361.cause:
The detected actual topology contains SINUMERIK and SIMOTION components.
The drive system is no longer booted. In this state, the drive control (closed-loop) cannot be enabled.
A01361.action:
Re alarm value = 1:
Replace all NX10 or NX15 by a CX32.
Re alarm value = 2:
Replace all CX32 by an NX10 or NX15.

A01362.cause:
At least one topology rule for the SINAMICS S120 Combi has been broken.
In the event of a fault, the ramping up of the drive system is aborted and closed-loop drive control is not enabled.
A01362.action: Evaluate the alarm value and ensure compliance with the corresponding topology rule(s).

A01381.cause:
The topology comparison has detected a power unit in the actual topology that has been shifted with respect to the
target topology.
A01381.action:
Adapting the topologies:
- undo the change to the actual topology by changing over the DRIVE-CLiQ cables.
- commissioning software: Go online, upload the drive unit, adapt the topology offline and download the modified
project.
- automatically remove the topology error (p9904).
A01381.note:
The connection in the actual topology where the shifted component was detected is described in dd, cc and bb.
Component class and connection number are described in F01375.
The drive system is no longer booted. In this state, the drive control (closed-loop) cannot be enabled.
Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

A01416.description: Topology: Comparison addition al component in actual topology

A01416.action:

- remove the additional component in the actual topology.
- download the target topology that matches the actual topology (commissioning software).

A01420.cause:
The component connected at the DRIVE-CLiQ socket does not correspond to the DRIVE-CLiQ component that was

A01420.action:
- insert the correct component.
- restore the factory setting.
- download an appropriate project.
A01420.note: The drive system is no longer booted. In this state, the drive control (closed-loop) cannot be enabled.

A01425.description: Topology: Comparison serial number of a component is different
A01425.cause:
The topology comparison has detected differences in the actual and target topologies in relation to one component.
The serial number is different.
A01425.action:
Adapting the topologies:
- change over the actual topology to match the target topology.
- download the target topology that matches the actual topology (commissioning software).
Re byte cc:
cc = 1 --> can be acknowledged using p9904 or p9905.
cc > 1 --> can be acknowledged using p9905 and can be de-activated using p9906 or p9907/p9908.
A01425.note:
The component class is described in F01375.
The drive system is no longer booted. In this state, the drive control (closed-loop) cannot be enabled.
Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

A01428.action:

A01429.description: Topology: Comparison connection is different for more than one component
A01429.cause:

component was connected to another connection.
The different connections of a component are described in the alarm value:
A01429.action:
Adapting the topologies:
- change over the actual topology to match the target topology.
- download the target topology that matches the actual topology (commissioning software).
A01429.note:
Component class and connection number are described in F01375.
The drive system is no longer booted. In this state, the drive control (closed-loop) cannot be enabled.
In the software, a Double Motor Module behaves just like two separate DRIVE-CLiQ nodes. If a Double Motor Module
is re-inserted, this can result in several differences in the actual topology.
Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

A01507.description: BICO: Interconnections to inactive objects present
A01507.cause:
There are BICO interconnections to an inactive/inoperable drive object.
The BI/CI parameters involved are listed in r9498.
The associated BO/CO parameters are listed in r9499.
The list of the BICO interconnections to other drive objects is displayed in r9491 and r9492 of the de-activated drive
object.
A01507.action:
- set all open BICO interconnections centrally to the factory setting with p9495 = 2.
- make the non-operational drive object active/operational again (re-insert or activate components).
A01507.note: r9498 and r9499 are only written to, if p9495 is not set to 0.

A01508.description: BICO: Interconnections to inactive objects exceeded
A01508.cause:
The maximum number of BICO interconnections (signal sinks) when de-activating a drive object was exceeded.
When de-activating a drive object, all BICO interconnections (signal sinks) are listed in the following parameters:
- r9498[0...29]: List of the BI/CI parameters involved.
- r9499[0...29]: List of the associated BO/CO parameters.
A01508.action:
The alarm automatically disappears as soon as no BICO interconnection (value = 0) is entered in r9498[29] and
r9499[29].

A01514.description: BICO: Error when  writing during a reconnect
A01514.cause:
During a reconnect operation (e.g. while booting or downloading - but can also occur in normal operation) a parameter was not able to be written to.
Example:
When writing to BICO input with double word format (DWORD), in the second index, the memory areas overlap (e.g.
p8861). The parameter is then reset to the factory setting.

A01590.cause: The selected service/maintenance interval for this motor was reached.
A01590.action: carry out service/maintenance and reset the service/maintenance interval (p0651).

A01631.description: SI P1: motor holding br ake/SBC configuration not practical
A01631.cause:
A configuration of motor holding brake and SBC was detected that is not practical.
The following configurations can result in this message:
- "No motor holding brake available" (p1215 = 0) and "SBC" enabled (p9602 = 1).
- "Motor holding brake just like the sequence control, connection via BICO" (p1215 = 3) and "SBC" enabled (p9602
= 1).
A01631.action: Check the parameterization of the motor holding brake and SBC and correct.

A01654.cause:
The configuration of a PROFIsafe telegram in the higher-level control (F-PLC) does not match the parameterization
in the drive.
A01654.action:
The following generally applies:
- check and, if necessary, correct the PROFIsafe configuration in the higher-level control.
Re alarm value = 1:
- remove the PROFIsafe configuring in the higher-level F control or enable PROFIsafe in the drive.
Re alarm value = 2:
- configure the PROFIsafe telegram to match the parameterization in the higher-level F-control.
A01654.note: This message does not result in a safety stop response.

A01666.description: SI Motion P1: Steady-state (static) 1 signal at the F-DI for safety-relevant
A01666.cause:
A logical 1 signal is present at the F-DI configured in p10006 for more than 10 seconds.
If, at the F-DI no acknowledgment was performed for safe acknowledgment, then a steady-state logical and 0 signal
must be present. This avoids unintentional safety-relevant acknowledgement (or the "Internal Event Acknowledge"
signal) if a wire breaks or one of the two digital inputs bounces.
A01666.action: Set the fail-safe digital input (F-DI) to a logical 0 signal (p10006).

A01669.description: SI Motion: Unfavorable combination of motor and power unit
A01669.cause:
The combination of motor and power unit used is not suitable for using safe motion monitoring functions without an
encoder.
The ratio between the power unit rated current (r0207[0]) and rated motor current (p0305) is greater than 5.
A01669.action: Use a suitable power unit with a lower power rating or a motor with a higher power rating.

A01693.description: SI Motion P1: Safety parameter setting changed, POWER ON required
A01693.cause: Safety parameters have been changed; these will only take effect following a POWER ON.
A01693.action:
- execute the function "Copy RAM to ROM".
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).

A01696.description: SI Motion: Testing of the motion monitoring functions selected when booting
A01696.cause:
The test of the motion monitoring functions was already illegally active when booting.
This is the reason that the test is only carried out again after selecting the forced checking procedure parameterized
in p9705.
A01696.action:
De-select the forced checking procedure of the safety motion monitoring functions and then select again.
The signal source for initiation is parameterized in binector input p9705.
A01696.note: This message does not result in a safety stop response.

A01697.description: SI Motion: Motion monitoring functions must be tested
A01697.cause:
The time set in p9559 for the forced checking procedure of the safety motion monitoring functions has been
exceeded. A new test is required.
After next selecting the forced checking procedure parameterized in p9705, the message is withdrawn and the monitoring time is reset.
A01697.action:
Carry out the forced checking procedure of the safety motion monitoring functions.
The signal source for initiation is parameterized in binector input p9705.
A01697.note:
- This message does not result in a safety stop response.
- As the shutdown paths are not automatically checked during booting, an alarm is always issued once booting is
complete.
- The test must be performed within a defined, maximum time interval (p9559, maximum of 9000 hours) in order to
comply with the requirements as laid down in the standards for timely fault detection and the conditions to calculate
the failure rates of safety functions (PFH value). Operation beyond this maximum time period is permissible if it can
be ensured that the forced checking procedure is performed before persons enter the hazardous area and who are
depending on the safety functions correctly functioning.

A01698.cause:
The commissioning of the "Safety Integrated" function is selected.
This message is withdrawn after the safety functions have been commissioned.
A01698.note:
- This message does not result in a safety stop response.
- In the safety commissioning mode, the "STO" function is internally selected.

A01699.description: SI P1: Shutdown path must be tested
A01699.cause:
The time set in p9659 for the forced checking procedure of the safety shutdown paths has been exceeded. The
safety shutdown paths must be re-tested.
After the next time the "STO" function is de-selected, the message is withdrawn and the monitoring time is reset.
The drive is stopped via a STOP A (pulses are suppressed via the safety shutdown path of processor 1).
Possible causes:
- stop request from processor 2.
- Pulses not suppressed after test stop selection.
- subsequent response to the message C01706 "SI Motion P1: SAM/SBR limit exceeded".
- Subsequent response to the message C01714 "SI Motion P1: Safely-Limited Speed exceeded".
- Subsequent response to the message C01701 "SI Motion P1: STOP B initiated".
The drive is stopped via a STOP B (braking along the OFF3 deceleration ramp).
As a result of this fault, after the speed threshold parameterized in p9560 is fallen below, message C01700 "STOP
A initiated" is output.
Possible causes:
- stop request from processor 2.
- Subsequent response to the message C01714 "SI Motion P1: Safely-Limited Speed exceeded".
- subsequent response to the message C01711 "SI Motion P1: Defect in a monitoring channel".
- subsequent response to the message C01707 "SI Motion P1: tolerance for safe operating stop exceeded".
Motion monitoring functions with set acceleration monitoring (SAM, p9506 = 3):
- after initiating STOP B (SS1) the velocity has exceeded the selected tolerance.
Motion monitoring functions with set brake ramp monitoring (SBR, p9506 = 1):
- after initiating STOP B (SS1) or SLS changeover to the lower speed stage, the speed has exceeded the selected
tolerance.
The drive is shut down by the message C01700 "SI Motion: STOP A initiated".

of the monitoring functions and initiated a STOP F. One of the monitoring functions no longer reliably functions - i.e.
safe operation is no longer possible.
If at least one monitoring function is active, then message C01701 "SI Motion: STOP B initiated" is output.
The message value that resulted in a STOP F is displayed in r9725. The message values described involve the
crosswise data comparison between processor 1 and processor 2.
The following message values may also occur in the following cases if the cause that is explicitly mentioned does
not apply:
- synchronization error between processor 1 and processor 2.

When cross checking and comparing the two monitoring channels, the drive detected a difference between parameters or results of the F-IO processing and initiated a STOP F. One of the monitoring functions no longer reliably
functions - i.e. safe operation is no longer possible.
The safety message C01711 with message value 0 is also displayed due to initiation of STOP F.
If at least one monitoring function is active, then safety message C01701 "SI Motion: STOP B initiated" is output.

Number of the cross-compared data that resulted in this message.

48: Selection F-DI for PROFIsafe (p10050, p10150)

50: SI SDI negative input terminal (p10031, p10131).
The drive has moved faster than that specified by the velocity limit value (p9531). The drive is stopped as a result of
the configured stop response (p9563).
Message value (r2124, interpret decimal):
100: SLS1 exceeded.
200: SLS2 exceeded.
300: SLS3 exceeded.
400: SLS4 exceeded.
The tolerance for the "safe motion direction" function was exceeded. The drive is stopped as a result of the configured stop response (p9566).
Message value (r9749, interpret decimal):
0: Tolerance for the "safe motion direction positive" function exceeded.
1: Tolerance for the "safe motion direction negative" function exceeded.
The fail-safe digital inputs (F-DI) show a different state longer than that parameterized in p10002 / p10102.
A01699.action:
Select STO and then de-select again.
- remove the cause of the fault on the monitoring channel of processor 2.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for message C01706.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for message C01714.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for message C01701.
- check the shutdown path of processor 1.
- replace Power Module.
- replace Control Unit.
This message can be acknowledged without a POWER ON as follows:
- via F-DI or PROFIsafe.
- remove the cause of the fault on the monitoring channel of processor 2.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for message C01714.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for message C01711.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for message C01707.
This message can be acknowledged without a POWER ON as follows:
- motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive: F-DI or PROFIsafe.
Check the braking behavior and, if necessary, adapt the parameterization of the parameter settings of the "SAM" or
the "SBR" function.
This message can be acknowledged without a POWER ON as follows:
- motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive: via F-DI or PROFIsafe.
Re message value = 0:
- no error was identified in this monitoring channel. Note the error message of the other monitoring channel (for processor 2: C30711).
Re message value = 3:
Commissioning phase:
- check the setting of the gear parameters on both monitoring channels (p9521/p9321, p9522/p9322).
- check the numerator of the gear ratio to ensure that it takes into account the motor pole pair number (p9522/p9322).
In operation:
- increase the ramp-function generator ramp-up/down time (p1120/p1121), reduce the dynamic performance of the
drive.
Re message value = 1 ... 999:
- if the message value is listed under cause: Check the crosswise-compared parameters to which the message value
refers.
- copy the safety parameters.
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- upgrade the Control Unit software.
Re message value = 1000:
- investigate the signal associated with the F-DI (contact problems).
Re message value = 1001:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- upgrade the Control Unit software.
Re message value = 1005:
- check the conditions for pulse enable.
Re message value = 1011:
- for diagnostics, refer to parameter (r9571).
Re message value = 1020:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- replace Control Unit.
Re message value = 1041:
- reduce the minimum current (p9588).
Re message value = 1042:
- increase the ramp-function generator ramp-up/down time (p1120/p1121).
- check that the current/speed control is set correctly (torque-generating/field-generating current and actual speed
value may not fluctuate).
- reduce the dynamic response of the setpoint value.
- increase the minimum current (p9588).
Re message value = 1043:
- increase the voltage tolerance (p9589).
- increase the ramp-function generator ramp-up/down time (p1120/p1121).
- check that the current/speed control is set correctly (torque-generating/field-generating current and actual speed
value may not fluctuate).
- reduce the dynamic response of the setpoint value.
Re message value = 6000 ... 6999:
Refer to the description of the message values in safety fault F01611.
This message can be acknowledged as follows:
- motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive: via F-DI or PROFIsafe
C01712 SI Motion P1: Defect in F-IO processing
- check parameterization in the parameters involved and correct if required.
- ensure equality by copying the SI data to processor 2 and then carry out an acceptance test.
- check the traversing/motion program in the control.
- check the limits for "Safely-Limited Speed (SLS) and if required, adapt (p9531).
This message can be acknowledged as follows:
- via F-DI or PROFIsafe.
- check the traversing/motion program in the control.
- check the tolerance for "SDI" function and if required, adapt (p9564).

the failure rates of safety functions (PFH value).

This message can be acknowledged via F-DI or PROFIsafe.
Discrepancy errors of an F-DI can only be completely acknowledged if safe acknowledgement was carried out once
the cause of the error was resolved (p10006 or acknowledgment via PROFIsafe). As long as safety acknowledgement was not carried out, the corresponding F-DI stays in the safe state internally.
For cyclic switching operations at the F-DI, it may be necessary to adapt the discrepancy time to the switching frequency.
If the period of a cyclic switching pulse corresponds to twice the value of p10002, then the following formulas should
be checked:
- p10002 < (tp / 2) - td (discrepancy time must be less than half the period minus the actual discrepancy time)
- p10002 >= p9500 (discrepancy time must be no less than p9500)
- p10002 > td (discrepancy time must be greater than the switch discrepancy time which may actually apply)
td = possible actual discrepancy time (in ms) that can occur with a switching operation. This must correspond to at
least 1 SI monitoring cycle (see p9500).
tp = period for a switching operation in ms.
When debounce p10017 is active, the discrepancy time is directly specified by the debounce time.
If the period of a cyclic switching pulse corresponds to twice the debounce time, then the following formulas should
be checked.
- p10002 < p10017 + 1 ms - td
- p10002 > td
- p10002 >= p9500
Example:
For a 12 ms SI monitoring cycle and a switching frequency of 110 ms (p10017 = 0), the maximum discrepancy time
which can be set is as follows:
p10002 <= (110/2 ms) - 12 ms = 43 ms
Rounded-off, p10002 <= 36 ms is obtained (since the discrepancy time can only be accepted as a whole SI monitoring cycle, the value will need to be rounded up or down to a whole SI monitoring cycle if the result is not an exact
multiple of an SI monitoring cycle).
F-DI: Failsafe Digital Input

A01772.description: SI Motion P1: Test stop failsafe inputs/outputs active
A01772.cause: The test stop for the fail-safe digital inputs (F-DI) and/or fail-safe digital outputs (F-DO) is presently being performed.
A01772.action:
The alarm disappears automatically after successfully ending or canceling (when a fault condition occurs) the test
stop.
A01772.note:
F-DI: Failsafe Digital Input
F-DO: Failsafe Digital Output

A01774.description: SI Motion P1: Test stop necessary
A01774.cause:
- after powering up the drive, a test stop has still not been carried out.
- a new test stop is required after commissioning.
- the time to carry out the forced checking procedure (test stop) has expired (p10003).
A01774.note:
- The test must be performed within a defined, maximum time interval (p10003, maximum of 8760 hours) in order to
comply with the requirements as laid down in the standards for timely fault detection and the conditions to calculate
the failure rates of safety functions (PFH value). Operation beyond this maximum time period is permissible if it can
be ensured that the forced checking procedure is performed before persons enter the hazardous area and who are
depending on the safety functions correctly functioning.

A01796.cause:
The drive waits for communication to be established to execute the safety-relevant motion monitoring functions.
The test stop is active.
The acceptance test mode is active.
A01796.action:
If, after a longer period of time, the message is not automatically withdrawn, the following checks have to be made:
- Check any other PROFIsafe communication messages/signals present and evaluate them.
- check the operating state of the F-Host.
- Check the communication connection to the F Host.
Not necessary.
The message is withdrawn when the test stop is finished.
C01799 SI Motion P1: Acceptance test mode active
Not necessary.
The message is withdrawn when exiting the acceptance test mode.
A01796.note: In this state, the pulses are safely suppressed.

A01839.description: DRIVE-CLiQ diagnostics: cable fault to the component
A01839.cause: The fault counter (r9936[0...199]) to monitor the DRIVE-CLiQ connections/cables has been incremented.
A01839.action:
- check the corresponding DRIVE-CLiQ cables.
- check the electrical cabinet design and cable routing for EMC compliance
A01839.note:
The component number specifies the component whose feeder cable from the direction of the Control Unit is faulted.
The alarm automatically disappears after 5 seconds, assuming that no other data transfer error has occurred.

A01840.description: SMI: Component found without motor data
A01840.cause: An SMI/DQI without motor data has been found (e.g. SMI installed as replacement part).
A01840.action:
1. Download the SMI/DQI data (motor/encoder data) from the data backup again (p4690, p4691).
2. Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for this component.
A01840.note:
DQI: DRIVE-CLiQ Sensor Integrated
SMI: SINAMICS Sensor Module Integrated

A01900.cause: A PROFIBUS master attempts to establish a connection using an incorrect configuring telegram.
A01900.action:
Check the bus configuration on the master and slave sides.
Re alarm value = 2:
Check the number of data words for input and output.
Re alarm value = 211:
Ensure offline version <= online version.
Re alarm value = 501:
Check the set PROFIsafe address (p9610).
Re alarm value = 502:
Check the enable of F-DI (p9501.30).

A01902.description: PB/PN clock cycle synchronous ope ration parameterization not permissible
A01902.cause: Parameterization for isochronous operation is not permissible.
A01902.action:
- Adapt the bus parameterization Tdp, Ti, To.
- adapt the current and speed controller clock cycle.
Re alarm value = 10:
- Reduce Tdx by using fewer bus participants or shorter telegrams.

A01920.cause: The cyclic connection to the PROFIBUS master is interrupted.
A01920.action: Establish the PROFIBUS connection and activate the PROFIBUS master in the cyclic mode.

A01921.cause:
Output data of PROFIBUS master (setpoints) received at the incorrect instant in time within the PROFIBUS clock
cycle.
A01921.action:
- check bus configuration.
- check parameters for clock cycle synchronization (ensure To > Tdx).
A01921.note:
To: Time of setpoint acceptance
Tdx: Data exchange time

A01930.description: PB/PN current controller clock cycle clock cycle synch. not equal
A01930.cause: The current controller clock cycle of all drives must be set the same for the clock cycle synchronous operation.
A01930.action: Set current controller clock cycles to identical values (p0115[0]).

A01931.description: PB/PN speed controller clock cycle clock cycle synch. not equal
A01931.cause: The speed controller clock cycle of all drives must be set the same for the clock cycle synchronous operation.
A01931.action: Set the speed controller clock cycles the same (p0115[1]).

A01932.description: PB/PN clock cycle sync hronization missing for DSC
A01932.cause: There is no clock synchronization or clock synchronous sign of life and DSC is selected.
A01932.action: Set clock synchronization across the bus configuration and transfer clock synchronous sign-of-life.

A01940.description: PB/PN clock cycle synchronism not reached
A01940.cause:
The bus is in the data exchange state and clock synchronous operation has been selected using the parameterizing
telegram. It was not possible to synchronize to the clock cycle specified by the master.
- the master does not send a clock synchronous global control telegram although clock synchronous operation was
selected when configuring the bus.
- the master is using another clock synchronous DP clock cycle than was transferred to the slave in the parameterizing telegram.
- at least one drive object has a pulse enable (not controlled from PROFIBUS/PROFINET either).
A01940.action:
- check the master application and bus configuration.
- check the consistency between the clock cycle input when configuring the slave and clock cycle setting at the master.
- check that no drive object has a pulse enable. Only enable the pulses after synchronizing the PROFIBUS/PROFINET drives.

A01941.description: PB/PN clock cycle signal missi ng when establishing bus communication
A01941.cause:
The bus is in the data exchange state and clock synchronous operation has been selected using the parameterizing
telegram. The global control telegram for synchronization is not being received.
A01941.action: Check the master application and bus configuration.

A01943.description: PB/PN clock cycle signal erro r when establishing bus communication
A01943.cause:
The bus is in the data exchange state and clock synchronous operation has been selected using the parameterizing
telegram.
The global control telegram for synchronization is being irregularly received.
-.the master is sending an irregular global control telegram.
- the master is using another clock synchronous DP clock cycle than was transferred to the slave in the parameterizing telegram.
A01943.action:
- check the master application and bus configuration.
- check the consistency between the clock cycle input when configuring the slave and clock cycle setting at the master.

A01944.cause:
The bus is in the data exchange state and clock synchronous operation has been selected using the parameterizing
telegram.
Synchronization with the master sign-of-life (STW2.12 ... STW2.15) could not be completed because the sign-of-life
is changing differently to how it was configured in the Tmapc time grid.
A01944.action:
- ensure that the master correctly increments the sign-of-life in the master application clock cycle Tmapc.
- correct the interconnection of the master sign-of-life (p2045).

A01945.description: PROFIBUS: Connection to the Publisher failed
A01945.cause: For PROFIBUS peer-to-peer data transfer, the connection to at least one Publisher has failed.
A01945.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Check the PROFIBUS cables.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- check the PROFIBUS cables.
- carry out a first commissioning of the Publisher that has the failed connection.

A01953.description: CU DRIVE-CLiQ: Synchronization not completed / CU SYNC: Synchronization not completed
A01953.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
After the drive system was powered up, synchronization between the basic clock cycle and application clock cycle
was started but was not completed within the selected time tolerance.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
After the drive system is powered up, the synchronization between the basic clock cycle, DRIVE-CLiQ clock cycle
and application clock cycle was started but was not completed within the selected time tolerance.
A01953.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
If the error occurs after the drive sampling times were changed, and if a Terminal Module 31 (TM31) is being used,
the sampling times (p0115, p4099) should be set as integer multiples to the drive clock cycles (p0115).

A01955.description: CU DRIVE-CLiQ: Synchronization DO not completed
A01955.cause:
After the drive system is powered up, the synchronization between the basic clock cycle, DRIVE-CLiQ clock cycle
and application clock cycle was started but was not completed within the selected time tolerance.
A01955.action: Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components of the DO.

A01990.cause: The configuration of the process data (PZD) for the USS protocol is incorrect.
A01990.action:
Re alarm value = 2:
Check the amount of USS PZD (p2022) and the maximum PZD amount (r2050/p2051) for the first drive object
(p0978[0]).

A02000.cause: The function generator has already been started.
A02000.action: Stop the function generator and restart again if necessary.
A02000.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02005.description: Function generator: Drive does not exist
A02005.cause: The drive object specified for connection does not exist.
A02005.action: Use the existing drive object with the corresponding number.
A02005.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02006.description: Function generator: No drive specified for connection
A02006.cause: No drive specified for connection in p4815.
A02006.action: At least one drive to be connected must be specified in p4815.
A02006.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02007.description: Function generator: Drive not SERVO / VECTOR / DC_CTRL
A02007.cause: The drive object specified for connection is not a SERVO / VECTOR or DC_CTRL.
A02007.action: Use a SERVO / VECTOR / DC_CTRL drive object with the corresponding number.
A02007.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02008.description: Function generator: Drive spec ified a multiple number of times
A02008.cause: The drive object specified for connection is already specified.
A02008.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02009.cause: The set operating mode (p1300) of the drive object is not permissible when using the function generator.
A02009.action:
Change the operating mode for this drive object to p1300 = 20 (encoderless speed control) or p1300 = 21 (speed
control with encoder).
A02009.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02010.description: Function generator: Speed setpoint from the drive is not zero
A02010.cause:
The speed setpoint of a drive selected for connection is greater than the value for the standstill detection set using
p1226.
A02010.action: For all of the drives specified for connection, set the speed setpoints to zero.
A02010.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02011.description: Function generator: The actual drive speed is not zero
A02011.cause:
The speed actual value of a drive selected for connection is greater than the value for the standstill detection set
using p1226.
A02011.action: Set the relevant drives to zero speed before starting the function generator.
A02011.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02015.description: Function generator: Drive enable signals missing
A02015.cause: The master control and/or enable signals are missing to connect to the specified drive.
A02015.action: Fetch the master control to the specified drive object and set all enable signals.
A02015.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02016.cause: Magnetizing has not yet been completed on a drive object specified for connection.
A02016.action: Wait for magnetizing of the motor (r0056.4).
A02016.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- restart the function generator.

A02020.description: Function generator: Parameter cannot be changed
A02020.cause: This parameter setting cannot be changed when the function generator is active (p4800 = 1).
A02020.action:
- stop the function generator before parameterizing (p4800 = 0).
- if required, start the function generator (p4800 = 1).
A02020.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02025.cause: The value for the period is too short.
A02025.action: Check and adapt the value for the period.
A02025.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02026.description: Function generator: Pulse width too high
A02026.cause:
The selected pulse width is too high.
The pulse width must be less than the period duration.
A02026.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02030.description: Function generator: Physical address equals zero
A02030.cause: The specified physical address is zero.
A02030.action: Set a physical address with a value other than zero.
A02030.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02040.description: Function generator: Illegal value for offset
A02040.cause: The value for the offset is higher than the value for the upper limit or lower than the value for the lower limit.
A02040.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02041.description: Function generator: Illegal value for bandwidth
A02041.cause:
The bandwidth referred to the time slice clock cycle of the function generator has either been set too low or too high.
Depending on the time slice clock cycle, the bandwidth is defined as follows:
Bandwidth_max = 1 / (2 x time slice clock cycle)
Bandwidth_min = Bandwidth_max / 100000
Example:
Assumption: p4830 = 125 µs
--> Bandwidth_max = 1 / (2 x 125 µs) = 4000 Hz
--> Bandwidth_min = 4000 Hz / 100000 = 0.04 Hz
A02041.action: Check the value for the bandwidth and adapt accordingly.
A02041.note:
p4823: Function generator bandwidth
p4830: Function generator time slice clock cycle
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02047.description: Function generator: Time slice clock cycle invalid
A02047.cause: The time slice clock cycle selected does not match any of the existing time slices.
A02047.action: Enter an existing time slice clock cycle. The existing time slices can be read out via p7901.
A02047.note:
The alarm is reset as follows:
- remove the cause of this alarm.
- restart the function generator.

A02050.cause: The trace has already been started.
A02050.action: Stop the trace and, if necessary, start again.

A02055.cause:
The trace duration is too short.
The minimum is twice the value of the trace clock cycle.
A02055.action: Check the selected recording time and, if necessary, adjust.

A02056.cause: The selected recording cycle is shorter than the selected basic clock cycle 0 (p0110[0]).
A02056.action: Increase the value for the trace cycle.

A02057.description: Trace: Time slice clock cycle invalid
A02057.cause: The time slice clock cycle selected does not match any of the existing time slices.
A02057.action: Enter an existing time slice clock cycle. The existing time slices can be read out via p7901.

A02058.description: Trace: Time slice clock cycle for endless trace not valid
A02058.cause: The selected time slice clock cycle cannot be used for the endless trace
A02058.action:
Enter the clock cycle of an existing time slice with a cycle time >= 2 ms for up to 4 recording channels or >= 4 ms
from 5 recording channels per trace.
The existing time slices can be read out via p7901.

A02059.description: Trace: Time slice clock cycle for 2 x 8 recording channels not valid
A02059.cause: The selected time slice clock cycle cannot be used for more than 4 recording channels.
A02059.action:
Enter the clock cycle of an existing time slice with a cycle time >= 4 ms or reduce the number of recording channels
to 4 per trace.
The existing time slices can be read out via p7901.

A02060.description: Trace: Signal to be traced missing
A02060.cause:
- a signal to be traced was not specified.
- the specified signals are not valid.
A02060.action:
- specify the signal to be traced.
- check whether the relevant signal can be traced.

A02061.cause:
- the specified signal does not exist.
- the specified signal can no longer be traced (recorded).
A02061.action:
- specify the signal to be traced.
- check whether the relevant signal can be traced.

A02062.cause:
- a trigger signal was not specified.
- the specified signal does not exist.
- the specified signal is not a fixed-point signal.
- the specified signal cannot be used as a trigger signal for the trace.

A02063.cause: The specified data type to select a signal using a physical address is invalid.

A02070.cause: The trace parameter settings cannot be changed when the trace is active.
A02070.action:
- stop the trace before parameterization.
- if required, start the trace.

A02075.cause: The selected pretrigger time must be shorter than the trace time.
A02075.action: Check the pretrigger time setting and change if necessary.

A02097.description: MTrace: multiple trace cannot be activated
A02097.cause:
The following functions or settings are not permissible in conjunction with a multiple trace:
- measuring function.
- long-time trace
- trigger condition "immediate recording start" (IMMEDIATE)
- trigger condition "start with function generator" (FG_START).
A02097.action:
- Deactivate multiple trace.
- Deactivate function or setting that is not permissible.

A02098.cause:
It is not possible to save the measurement results of a multiple trace on the memory card.
A multiple trace is not started or is canceled.
A02098.action:
- insert or remove the memory card.
- use a larger memory card.
- configure the trace with a longer trace time or use an endless trace.
- avoid saving parameters while the multiple trace is running. Saving parameters can
Block writing measurement result files to the card, so that this alarm is output with alarm value 3
- check whether other functions are presently accessing measurement result files of the multiple trace.

A02099.description: Trace: Insufficie nt Control Unit memory
A02099.cause: The memory space still available on the Control Unit is no longer sufficient for the trace function.
A02099.action:
Reduce the memory required, e.g. as follows:
- reduce the trace time.
- increase the trace clock cycle.
- reduce the number of signals to be traced.

A02100.description: Drive: Computing dead time current controller too short
A02100.cause:
The value in p0118 produces a dead time of one clock cycle because it is prior to setpoint availability.
Possible causes:
- A parameter backup with a version higher than 4.3 was loaded to a version less than or equal to 4.3.
- The system properties after replacing a component no longer match the parameter assignment.
A02100.action:
- set p0118 to zero.
- set p0118 to a value greater than or equal to the alarm value (for p1810.11 = 1)
- set p0117 (from the device) to an automatic setting (p0117 = 1).
- check the firmware versions of the components involved.

A02150.cause: The system was not able to load an OA application.
A02150.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

A03501.cause:
The sampling times of the inputs/outputs were changed.
This change only becomes valid after the next boot.

A03506.cause: The 24 V power supply for the digital outputs (X124) is missing.
A03506.action: Check the terminals for the power supply voltage (X124, L1+, M).

A03510.description: CU: Calibration data not plausible / TM: Calibration data not plausible
A03510.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
During booting, the calibration data for the analog inputs is read and checked with respect to plausibility.
At least one calibration data point was determined to be invalid.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
During ramp-up, the Terminal Module 31 (TM31) calibration data is read in and checked for plausibility.
At least one calibration data point was determined to be invalid.
A03510.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- power down/power up the power supply for the Control Unit.
If it reoccurs, replace the module.
In principle, operation could continue.
The analog channel involved possibly does not achieve the specified accuracy.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- power down/power up the power supply for the Control Unit.
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
A03510.note:
If it reoccurs, then replace the module.
In principle, operation could continue.
The analog channel involved possibly does not achieve the specified accuracy.

A03520.description: CU: Temperature sensor fault / TM: Temperature sensor fault
A03520.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
When evaluating the temperature sensor, an error occurred.
It is expected that an LG-Ni1000 temperature sensor (p0756[2...3] = 6) or PT1000 p0756[2...3] = 7 is connected via
the analog input.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
When evaluating the temperature sensor, an error occurred.
A03520.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- make sure that the sensor is connected correctly.
- check the sensor for correct function and if required, replace.
- change over the analog input to type "no sensor connected" (p0756 = 8).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- make sure that the sensor is connected correctly.
- replace the sensor.

A03550.description: TM: Speed setpoint filter natural frequency > Shannon frequency
A03550.cause:
The natural filter frequency of the speed setpoint filter (p1417) is greater than or equal to the Shannon frequency.
The Shannon frequency is calculated according to the following formula:
0.5 / p4099[3]
A03550.action: Reduce the natural frequency of the speed setpoint filter (PT2 low pass) (p1417).

A05000.description: Power unit: Overtemperature heat sink AC inverter
A05000.cause:
The alarm threshold for overtemperature at the inverter heat sink has been reached. The response is set using
p0290.
If the temperature of the heat sink increases by an additional 5 K, then fault F30004 is initiated.
A05000.action:
Check the following:
- is the ambient temperature within the defined limit values?
- have the load conditions and the load duty cycle been appropriately dimensioned?
- has the cooling failed?

A05001.description: Power unit: Overtemperature depletion layer chip
A05001.cause: Alarm threshold for overtemperature of the power semiconductor in the AC converter has been reached.
A05001.action:
Check the following:
- is the ambient temperature within the defined limit values?
- have the load conditions and the load duty cycle been appropriately dimensioned?
- has the cooling failed?
- pulse frequency too high?
A05001.note:
- The response is set using p0290.
- If the depletion layer temperature increases by an additional 15 K, then fault F30025 is triggered.

A05002.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
For chassis power units, the following applies:
The alarm threshold for the air intake overtemperature has been reached. For air-cooled power units, the threshold
is 42 °C (hysteresis 2 K). The response is set using p0290.
If the air intake temperature increases by an additional 13 K, then fault F30035 is output.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The alarm threshold for the air intake overtemperature has been reached. For air-cooled power units, the threshold
is 42 °C (hysteresis 2 K). The response is set using p0290.
If the air intake temperature increases by an additional 13 K, then fault F30035 is output.
A05002.action:
Check the following:
- is the ambient temperature within the defined limit values?
- has the fan failed? Check the direction of rotation.

A05003.cause:
The alarm threshold for internal overtemperature has been reached.
If the temperature inside the power unit increases by an additional 5 K, then fault F30036 is triggered.
A05003.action:
Check the following:
- is the ambient temperature within the defined limit values?
- has the fan failed? Check the direction of rotation.

A05004.cause:
The alarm threshold for the overtemperature of the rectifier has been reached. The response is set using p0290.
If the temperature of the rectifier increases by an additional 5 K, then fault F30037 is triggered.
A05004.action:
Check the following:
- is the ambient temperature within the defined limit values?
- have the load conditions and the load duty cycle been appropriately dimensioned?
- has the fan failed? Check the direction of rotation.
- has a phase of the line supply failed?
- is an arm of the supply (incoming) rectifier defective?

A05005.description: Cooling unit: Cooling medium flow rate too low
A05005.cause: Cooling unit: Alarm - flow rate has fallen below the alarm value
A05005.action:
- Check the feedback signals and parameter assignment (p0260 ... p0267).
- Check the coolant feed.

A05006.cause:
The temperature difference between the chip and heat sink has exceeded the permissible limit value (blocksize
power units only).
Depending on p0290, an appropriate overload response is initiated.
A05006.action:
Not necessary.
The alarm disappears automatically once the limit value is undershot.
A05006.note: If the alarm does not disappear automatically and the temperature continues to rise, this can result in fault F30024.

A05054.cause:
For the drive object involved, fewer power units connected in parallel are active than exist in the target topology.
Operation is only possible at reduced power (power derating).
A05054.action: Re-activate the de-activated power units if required.

A06921.cause: The three resistors of the braking chopper are not symmetrical.
A06921.action:
- check the feeder cables to the braking resistors.
- If required, increase the value for detecting dissymmetry (p1364).

A07012.description: Drive: Motor temperature model 1 overtemperature / Drive: Motor temperature model 1/3 overtemperature
A07012.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The thermal I2t motor model for synchronous motors identified that the alarm threshold was exceeded.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The motor temperature model 1/3 identified that the alarm threshold was exceeded.
A07012.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- check the motor load and if required, reduce.
- check the motor ambient temperature.
- check the thermal time constant (p0611).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- check the motor load and if required, reduce.
- check the motor ambient temperature.
- check activation of the motor temperature model (p0612).
Motor temperature model 1 (I2t):
- check the thermal time constant (p0611).
- check the alarm threshold (p0605).
Motor temperature model 3:
- check the motor type.
- check the alarm threshold (p5398).
- check the model parameters.
A07012.note: p0605 has no influence on the time up to an alarm being issued.

A07014.description: Drive: Motor temperature model configuration alarm
A07014.cause: A fault has occurred in the configuration of the motor temperature model.
A07014.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- set the response for motor overtemperature to "Alarm and fault, no reduction of I_max" (p0610 = 2).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- set the response for motor overtemperature to "Alarm and fault, no reduction of I_max" (p0610 = 2).
- check and correct the threshold values (p5398, p5399).

A07015.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
An error was detected when evaluating the temperature sensor set in p0601.
With the fault, the time in p0607 is started. If the fault is still present after this time has expired, then fault F07016 is
output; however, at the earliest, 50 ms after alarm A07015.
Possible causes:
- wire breakage or sensor not connected (KTY: R > 2120 Ohm).
- measured resistance too low (PTC: R < 20 Ohm, KTY: R < 50 Ohm).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
An error was detected when evaluating the temperature sensor set in p0600 and p0601.
With the fault, the time in p0607 is started. If the fault is still present after this time has expired, then fault F07016 is
output; however, at the earliest, 50 ms after alarm A07015.
Possible causes:
- wire breakage or sensor not connected (KTY: R > 1630 Ohm).
- measured resistance too low (PTC: R < 20 Ohm, KTY: R < 50 Ohm).
A07015.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- make sure that the sensor is connected correctly.
- check the parameterization (p0601).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- make sure that the sensor is connected correctly.
- check the parameterization (p0600, p0601).

A07089.description: Changing over units: Function module activation is blocked because the units have
A07089.cause:
An attempt was made to activate a function module. This is not permissible if the units have already been changed
over.
A07089.action: Restore units that have been changed over to the factory setting.

A07200.description: Drive: Master control ON command present
A07200.cause:
The ON/OFF1 command is present (no 0 signal).
The command is either influenced via binector input p0840 (current CDS) or control word bit 0 via the master control.
A07200.action: Switch the signal via binector input p0840 (current CDS) or control word bit 0 via the master control to 0.

A07321.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The automatic restart (AR) is active. When the line supply returns and/or the causes of the existing faults are
removed the drive is automatically restarted. The pulses are enabled and the motor starts to rotate.
For p1210 = 26, the alarm after the line supply returns is also displayed if there is no fault and there is no ON command. Restarting is realized with the delayed setting of the ON command.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The automatic restart (AR) is active. When the line supply returns and/or the causes of the existing faults are
removed the drive is automatically restarted. The pulses are enabled and the motor starts to rotate.
A07321.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- the automatic restart (AR) should, if required, be inhibited (p1210 = 0).
- an automatic restart can be directly interrupted by withdrawing the power-on command (BI: p0840).
- for p1210 = 26: by withdrawing the OFF2- / OFF3 control commands.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- the automatic restart (AR) should, if required, be inhibited (p1210 = 0).
- an automatic restart can be directly interrupted by withdrawing the power-on command (BI: p0840).

A07329.description: Drive: kT estimator, kT(iq) characteristic or voltage compensation does not function
A07329.cause: A function of the function module "extended torque control" (r0108.1) was activated - however the (complete) function is not available.
A07329.action:
Re fault value = 1, 2:
- carry out an identification of the voltage emulation error in the drive converter (p1909.14 = 1, p1910 = 1).
- set the parameter to compensate the voltage emulation error in the drive converter (p1952, p1953).
For fault value = 3:
- enable the compensation of the voltage emulation error in the drive converter (p1780.8 = 1).
For fault value = 4:
- activate the function module "extended torque control" (r0108.1 = 1) or de-activate the corresponding functions
(p1780.3 = 0, p1780.8 = 0, p1780.9 = 0).

A07350.description: Drive: Measuring probe parameterized to a digital output
A07350.cause: The measuring probe is connected to a bi-directional digital input/output and the terminal is set as output.
A07350.action:
- set the terminal as input (p0728).
- de-select the measuring probe (p0488, p0489, p0580).

A07400.description: Drive: DC link voltage maximum controller active
A07400.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The DC link voltage controller has been activated because the upper switch-in threshold has been exceeded (r1242,
r1282).
The ramp-down times are automatically increased in order to maintain the DC link voltage (r0070) within the permissible limits. There is a system deviation between the setpoint and actual speeds.
When the DC link voltage controller is switched out (disabled), this is the reason that the ramp-function generator
output is set to the speed actual value.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The DC link voltage controller has been activated because of the upper switch-in threshold (p1244).
A system deviation can occur between the setpoint and actual speed.
A07400.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
If the controller is not to intervene:
- increase the ramp-down times.
- switch-off the Vdc_max controller (p1240 = 0 for vector control, p1280 = 0 for U/f control).
If the ramp-down times are not to be changed:
- use a chopper or regenerative feedback unit.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Not necessary.
This alarm automatically disappears after the upper threshold has been distinctly undershot.
Otherwise, apply the following measures:
- use a Braking Module or regenerative feedback unit.
- increase the ramp-down times (p1121, p1135).
- shut down the Vdc_max controller (p1240 = 0).

A07401.description: Drive: DC link voltage maximum controller de-activated
A07401.cause:
The Vdc_max controller can no longer maintain the DC link voltage (r0070) below the limit value (r1242, r1282) and
was therefore switched out (disabled).
- the line supply voltage is permanently higher than specified for the power unit.
- the motor is permanently in the regenerative mode as a result of a load that is driving the motor.
A07401.action:
- check whether the input voltage is within the permissible range.
- check whether the load duty cycle and load limits are within the permissible limits.

A07402.description: Drive: DC link voltage minimum controller active
A07402.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The DC link voltage controller has been activated as the lower switch-in threshold has been undershot (r1246,
r1286).
The kinetic energy of the motor is used to buffer the DC link. The drive is therefore braked.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The DC link voltage controller has been activated due to the lower switch-in threshold (p1248).
A system deviation can occur between the setpoint and actual speed.
A possible cause can be e.g. that the line supply has failed.
A07402.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The alarm disappears when power supply returns.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Not necessary.
This alarm automatically disappears after the lower threshold has been distinctly exceeded.
Otherwise, apply the following measures:
- check the line supply and infeed.
- increase the ramp-up times (p1120).
- shut down the Vdc_min controller (p1240 = 0).

A07409.description: Drive: U/f control, curre nt limiting controller active
A07409.cause: The current limiting controller of the U/f control was activated because the current limit was exceeded.
A07409.action:
The alarm automatically disappears after one of the following measures:
- increase current limit (p0640).
- reduce the load.
- slow down the ramp up to the setpoint speed.

A07416.cause: The configuration of the flux control (p1401) is contradictory.
A07416.action:
Re fault cause = 1:
- Shut down soft start (p1401.0 = 0).
- Shut down quick magnetizing (p1401.6 = 0).
Re fault cause = 2:
- De-energize flux build-up control (p1401.2 = 0).
- Shut down quick magnetizing (p1401.6 = 0).
Re fault cause = 3:
- Re-parameterize Rs identification (p0621 = 0, 1)
- Shut down quick magnetizing (p1401.6 = 0).

A07428.cause: The technology controller has a parameterizing error.
A07428.action:
Re alarm value = 1:
Set the output limit in p2291 higher than in p2292.

A07440.cause:
The calculation of the jerk time Tr = max(p2572, p2573) / p2574 resulted in an excessively high value so that the jerk
time is internally limited to 1000 ms.
A07440.action:
- increase the jerk limiting (p2574).
- reduce maximum acceleration or maximum deceleration (p2572, p2573).
A07440.note: The alarm is also output if jerk limiting is not active.

A07441.description: LR: Save the position offset of the absolute encoder adjustment
A07441.cause:
The status of the absolute encoder adjustment has changed.
In order to permanently save the determined position offset (p2525) it must be saved in a non-volatile fashion
(p0971).
A07441.action:
Not necessary.
This alarm automatically disappears after the offset has been saved.

A07454.description: LR: Position actual value preprocessing does not have a valid encoder
A07454.cause:
One of the following problems has occurred with the position actual value preprocessing:
- an encoder is not assigned for the position actual value preprocessing (p2502 = 0).
- an encoder is assigned, but no encoder data set (p0187 = 99 or p0188 = 99).
- an encoder an an encoder data set have been assigned, however, the encoder data set does not contain any
encoder data (p0400 = 0) or invalid data (e.g. p0408 = 0).
A07454.action: Check the drive data sets, encoder data sets and encoder assignment.

A07455.cause:
The maximum velocity (p2571) is too high to correctly calculate the modulo correction.
Within the sampling time for positioning (p0115[5]), with the maximum velocity, a maximum of the half modulo length
must be moved through. p2571 was limited to this value.

A07456.cause: The actual setpoint velocity is greater than the parameterized maximum velocity (p2571) and is therefore limited.
A07456.action:
- check the entered setpoint velocity.
- reduce the velocity override (CI: p2646).
- increase the maximum velocity (p2571).
- check the signal source for the externally limited velocity (CI: p2594).

A07457.description: EPOS: Combination of input signals illegal
A07457.cause: An illegal combination of input signals that are simultaneously set was identified.
A07457.action: Check the appropriate input signals and correct.

A07461.cause: When starting a traversing block/direct setpoint input, a reference point is not set (r2684.11 = 0).
A07461.action: Reference the system (search for reference, flying referencing, set reference point).

A07462.description: EPOS: Selected traversing block number does not exist
A07462.cause:
A traversing block selected via binector input p2625 ... p2630 was started via binector input p2631 = 0/1 edge "Activate traversing task".
- the number of the started traversing block is not contained in p2616[0...n].
- the started traversing block is suppressed.
A07462.action:
- correct the traversing program.
- select an available traversing block number.

A07463.description: EPOS: External block change not requested in the traversing block
A07463.cause:
For a traversing block with the block change enable CONTINUE_EXTERNAL_ALARM, the external block change
was not requested.
A07463.action: Resolve the reason as to why the edge is missing at binector input (BI: p2632).

A07465.description: EPOS: Traversing block does not have a subsequent block
A07465.cause: There is no subsequent block in the traversing block.
A07465.action:
- parameterize this traversing block with the block change enable END.
- parameterize additional traversing blocks with a higher block number and for the last block, using the block change
enable END.

A07466.description: EPOS: Traversing block number assigned a multiple number of times
A07466.cause: The same traversing block number was assigned a multiple number of times.

A07467.description: EPOS: Traversing block has illegal task parameters
A07467.cause: The task parameter in the traversing block contains an illegal value.
A07467.action: Correct the task parameter in the traversing block.

A07468.description: EPOS: Traversing block jump destination does not exist
A07468.cause: In a traversing block, a jump was programmed to a non-existent block.
A07468.action:
- correct the traversing block.
- add the missing traversing block.

A07469.description: EPOS: Traversing block < target position < software limit switch minus
A07469.cause:
In the traversing block the specified absolute target position lies outside the range limited by the software limit switch
minus.
A07469.action:
- correct the traversing block.
- change software limit switch minus (CI: p2578, p2580).

A07470.description: EPOS: Traversing block> target position > software limit switch plus
A07470.cause:
In the traversing block the specified absolute target position lies outside the range limited by the software limit switch
plus.
A07470.action:
- correct the traversing block.
- change software limit switch plus (CI: p2579, p2581).

A07471.description: EPOS: Traversing block target position outside the modulo range
A07471.cause: In the traversing block the target position lies outside the modulo range.
A07471.action:
- in the traversing block, correct the target position.
- change the modulo range (p2576).

A07472.description: EPOS: Traversing block ABS_POS/ABS_NEG not possible
A07472.cause:
