A37034.cause:
The alarm threshold for internal overtemperature has been reached.
If the temperature inside the unit continues to increase, fault F37036 may be triggered.
- ambient temperature might be too high.
- insufficient cooling, fan failure.
A37034.action:
- check the ambient temperature.
- check the fan for the inside of the unit.

A37041.description: HF Damping Module: 24 V undervoltage alarm
A37041.cause:
Fault in the 24 V power supply for the HF Damping Module.
- the 16 V threshold was undershot..
A37041.action:
- check the 24 V DC voltage supply of the HF Damping Module.
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for the component.

A37044.description: HF Damping Module: 24 V overvoltage alarm
A37044.cause:
Fault in the 24 V power supply for the HF Damping Module.
- the 32.0 V threshold was exceeded.
A37044.action: Check the 24 V DC voltage supply of the HF Damping Module.

A37049.description: HF Damping Module: Internal fan defective
A37049.cause: The internal fan of the HF Damping Module has failed.
A37049.action: Check the internal fan of the HF Damping Module and replace if necessary.

A37056.description: HF damping module: Heat sink overtemperature
A37056.cause:
The temperature of the HF Damping Module heat sink has exceeded the permissible limit value.
- insufficient cooling, fan failure.
- overload.
- ambient temperature too high.
A37056.action:
- check whether the fan is running.
- check the fan elements.
- check whether the ambient temperature is in the permissible range.

A37310.cause:
The temperature of the HF Choke Module heat sink has exceeded the permissible limit value.
- insufficient cooling, fan failure.
- overload.
- ambient temperature too high.
A37310.action:
- check whether the fan is running.
- check the fan elements.
- check whether the ambient temperature is in the permissible range.

A37312.description: HF Choke Module: Overtemperature or fan failure
A37312.cause:
The HF Choke Module signals an overtemperature or fan failure.
Fault F37313 is output if the alarm is present for longer than 30 s.
A37312.action:
- The cable between the HF Choke Module and the HF Damping Module has been withdrawn or is defective (X21).
- Check the fan of the HF Choke Module and replace if necessary.
- check whether the ambient temperature is in the permissible range.
A37312.note:
HF choke module (reactor module)
HF Damping Module

A37502.description: HF damping module: Damping voltage too high
A37502.cause:
The damping voltage has exceeded the alarm threshold.
- A motor harmonic with a high amplitude has coincided with the resonance frequency of the output filter.
- The current controller excessively excites the resonance of the output filter.
If the damping voltage exceeds an inadmissibly high value, F37002 is output.
A37502.action:
- Reduce the motor power in the proximity of the fault-generating frequency.
- Check the current controller and if required, adapt.
- If required, use another motor.

A37801.cause:
There is a DRIVE-CLiQ communication error between the Control Unit and the HF Damping Module.
Fault cause:
10 (= 0A hex):
The sign-of-life bit in the receive telegram is not set.
Note regarding the message value:
The individual information is coded as follows in the message value (r0949/r2124):
0000yyxx hex: yy = component number, xx = error cause
A37801.action:
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- replace the component involved.

- upgrade the firmware on the Control Unit (r0018).
A37999.note:
If required, the significance of this new alarm can be read about in a more recent description of the Control Unit.
HF Damping Module

A40100.cause: An alarm has occurred at the drive object at the DRIVE-CLiQ socket X100.
A40100.action: Evaluate the alarm buffer of the specified object.

A40101.cause: An alarm has occurred at the drive object at the DRIVE-CLiQ socket X101.
A40101.action: Evaluate the alarm buffer of the specified object.

A40102.cause: An alarm has occurred at the drive object at the DRIVE-CLiQ socket X102.
A40102.action: Evaluate the alarm buffer of the specified object.

A40103.cause: An alarm has occurred at the drive object at the DRIVE-CLiQ socket X103.
A40103.action: Evaluate the alarm buffer of the specified object.

A40104.action: Evaluate the alarm buffer of the specified object.

A40105.cause: An alarm has occurred at the drive object at the DRIVE-CLiQ socket X105.
A40105.action: Evaluate the alarm buffer of the specified object.

A50001.cause:
A PROFINET controller attempts to establish a connection using an incorrect configuring telegram. The "Shared
Device" function has been activated (p8929 = 2).
A50001.action: Check the configuration of the PROFINET controllers as well as the p8929 setting.

A50010.cause: PROFINET Name of Station is invalid.
A50010.action: Correct the name of the station (p8920) and activate (p8925 = 2).

A50020.cause: The PROFINET function "Shared Device" has been activated (p8929 = 2). However, only the connection to a PROFINET controller is present.
A50020.action: Check the configuration of the PROFINET controllers as well as the p8929 setting.

A50513.description: FBLOCKS: Run sequence value already assigned
A50513.cause:
An attempt was made to assign a run sequence value already assigned to a function block on this drive object to
another additional function block on the same drive object. A run sequence value can only be precisely assigned to
one function block on one drive object.
A50513.action: Set another value that is still available on this drive object for the run sequence.

A50517.cause: A Siemens internal measurement has been activated.
A50517.action: Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for the Control Unit involved.

F01000.cause: An internal software error has occurred.
F01000.action:
- evaluate fault buffer (r0945).
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- if required, check the data on the non-volatile memory (e.g. memory card).
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.
- replace the Control Unit.

F01001.cause:
An exception occurred during an operation with the FloatingPoint data type.
The error may be caused by the basic system or an OA application (e.g., FBLOCKS, DCC).
F01001.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- check configuration and signals of the blocks in FBLOCKS.
- check configuration and signals of DCC charts.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.
F01001.note:
Refer to r9999 for further information about this fault.
r9999[0]: Fault number.
r9999[1]: Program counter at the time when the exception occurred.
r9999[2]: Cause of the FloatingPoint exception.
Bit 0 = 1: Operation invalid
Bit 1 = 1: Division by zero
Bit 2 = 1: Overflow
Bit 3 = 1: Underflow
Bit 4 = 1: Inaccurate result

F01002.cause: An internal software error has occurred.
F01002.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

F01003.description: Acknowledgement delay when accessing the memory
F01003.cause: A memory area was accessed that does not return a "READY".
F01003.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- contact the Hotline.

F01005.description: File upload/download error / Firmware download for DRIVE-CLiQ component unsuccessful
F01005.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The upload or download of EEPROM data was unsuccessful.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
It was not possible to download the firmware to a DRIVE-CLiQ component.
F01005.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Save a suitable firmware file or EEPROM file for upload or download in folder "/ee_sac/" on the memory card.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- check the selected component number (p7828).
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- save suitable firmware file for download in the directory "/siemens/sinamics/code/sac/".
- use a component with a suitable hardware version
- after POWER ON has been carried out again for the DRIVE-CLiQ component, download the firmware again.
Depending on p7826, the firmware will be automatically downloaded.

F01010.cause: An unknown drive type was found.
F01010.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- replace Power Module.
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- replace Power Module.
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

F01011.action:
- check the communication cable.
- download the project again.
- boot from previously saved files (power-down/power-up or p0976).
- when loading into the file system (download from memory card), use the matching version.
F01011.note: The response to an interrupted download is the state "first commissioning".

F01012.cause: When converting the project of an older firmware version, an error occurred.
F01012.action:
Check the parameter indicated in the fault value and correctly adjust it accordingly.
For fault value = 600:
Parameter p0600 must be set to the values 1, 2 or 3 in accordance with the assignment of the internal encoder evaluation to the encoder interface.
Value 1 means: The internal encoder evaluation is assigned to the encoder interface 1 via p0187.
Value 2 means: The internal encoder evaluation is assigned to the encoder interface 2 via p0188.
Value 3 means: The internal encoder evaluation is assigned to the encoder interface 3 via p0189.
- If necessary, the internal encoder evaluation must be assigned to an encoder interface via parameters p0187,
p0188 or p0189 accordingly.
- If necessary, upgrade the firmware to a later version.

F01015.cause: An internal software error has occurred.
F01015.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

F01018.description: Booting has been interrupted several times
F01018.cause:
Module booting was interrupted several times. As a consequence, the module boots with the factory setting.
Possible reasons for booting being interrupted:
- power supply interrupted.
- CPU crashed.
- parameterization invalid.
F01018.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on). After switching on, the module reboots from the valid parameterization (if
available).
- restore the valid parameterization.
Examples:
a) Carry out a first commissioning, save, carry out a POWER ON (switch-off/switch-on).
b) Load another valid parameter backup (e.g. from the memory card), save, carry out a POWER ON (switchoff/switch-on).
F01018.note: If the fault situation is repeated, then this fault is again output after several interrupted boots.

F01023.cause: An internal software timeout has occurred.
F01023.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

F01030.cause:
For active PC master control, no sign-of-life was received within the monitoring time.
The master control was returned to the active BICO interconnection.
F01030.action:
Set the monitoring time higher at the PC or, if required, completely disable the monitoring function.
For the commissioning software, the monitoring time is set as follows:
<Drive> -> Commissioning -> Control panel -> Button "Fetch master control" -> A window is displayed to set the monitoring time in milliseconds.

F01031.description: Sign-of-life failure for OFF in REMOTE
F01031.cause: With the "OFF in REMOTE" mode active, no sign-of-life was received within 3 seconds.
F01031.action:
- Check the data cable connection at the serial interface for the Control Unit (CU) and operator panel.
- Check the data cable between the Control Unit and operator panel.

F01033.description: Units changeover: Reference parameter value invalid
F01033.cause: When changing over the units to the referred representation type, it is not permissible for any of the required reference parameters to be equal to 0.0
F01033.action: Set the value of the reference parameter to a number different than 0.0.

F01034.description: Units changeover: Calculation parameter values after reference value change
F01034.cause: The change of a reference parameter meant that for an involved parameter the selected value was not able to be recalculated in the per unit representation. The change was rejected and the original parameter value restored.
F01034.action: Select the value of the reference parameter such that the parameter involved can be calculated in the per unit representation.

F01036.cause:
When downloading the device parameterization, a parameter back-up file PSxxxyyy.ACX associated with a drive
object cannot be found.
F01036.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
If you have saved the project data using the commissioning software, carry out a new download for your project.
Save using the function "Copy RAM to ROM" or with P0971 = 1
This means that the parameter files are again completely written into the non-volatile memory.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
If you have saved the project data using the commissioning software, carry out a new download for your project.
Save using the function "Copy RAM to ROM" or with p0977 = 1
This means that the parameter files are again completely written into the non-volatile memory.
F01036.note: If the project data have not been backed up, then a new first commissioning is required.

F01038.description: ACX: Loading the parameter back-up file unsuccessful
F01038.cause: An error has occurred when downloading PSxxxyyy.ACX or PTxxxyyy.ACX files from the non-volatile memory.
F01038.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- If you have saved the project data using the commissioning software, download the project again. Save using the
function "Copy RAM to ROM" or with p0971 = 1 so that all of the parameter files are again completely written to the
non-volatile memory.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- If you have saved the project data using the commissioning software, download the project again. Save using the
function "Copy RAM to ROM" or with p0977 = 1 so that all of the parameter files are again completely written to the
non-volatile memory.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.
Re byte 2 = 255:
- Correct the drive object type (see p0107).

F01039.description: ACX: Writing to the parameter back-up file was unsuccessful
F01039.cause:
Writing to at least one parameter back-up file PSxxxyyy.*** in the non-volatile memory was unsuccessful.
- In the directory /USER/SINAMICS/DATA/ at least one parameter back-up file PSxxxyyy.*** has the "read only" file
attribute and cannot be overwritten.
- There is not sufficient free memory space available.
- The non-volatile memory is defective and cannot be written to.
F01039.action:
- check the file attribute of the files (PSxxxyyy.***, CAxxxyyy.***, CCxxxyyy.***) and, if required, change from "read
only" to "writeable".
- check the free memory space in the non-volatile memory. Approx. 80 kbyte of free memory space is required for
every drive object in the system.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.

F01040.description: Save parameter settings and carry out a POWER ON
F01040.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
A parameter has been changed that requires the parameters to be backed up and the Control Unit to be switched
OFF and ON again.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
A parameter was changed in the drive system which means that it is necessary to save the parameters and re-boot.
F01040.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- Save parameters (p0971).
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for the Control Unit.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- save the parameters (p0971/p0977).
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
Then:
- upload the drive unit (commissioning software).

F01041.cause: Defective or missing files were detected on the memory card when booting.
F01041.action:
- save the parameters.
- download the project again to the drive unit.
- update the firmware
- if required, replace the Control Unit and/or memory card card.

F01042.cause:
An error was detected when downloading a project using the commissioning software (e.g. incorrect parameter
value).
For the specified parameter, it was detected that dynamic limits were exceeded that may possibly depend on other
parameters.
F01042.action:
- enter the correct value in the specified parameter.
- identify the parameter that restricts the limits of the specified parameter.

F01043.cause: A fatal error was detected when downloading a project using the commissioning software.
F01043.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- use the current version of the commissioning software.
- modify the offline project and download again (e.g. compare the motor and Power Module in the offline project and
on the drive).
- change the drive state (is a drive rotating or is there a message/signal?).
- carefully note any other messages/signals and remove their cause.
- boot from previously saved files (power-down/power-up or p0970=10,..).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- use the current version of the commissioning software.
- modify the offline project and carry out a new download (e.g. compare the number of drive objects, motor, encoder,
power unit in the offline project and at the drive).
- change the drive state (is a drive rotating or is there a message/signal?).
- carefully note any other messages/signals and remove their cause.
- boot from previously saved files (power-down/power-up or p0976).

F01044.cause: An error was detected when loading the descriptive data saved in the non-volatile memory.
F01044.action: Replace the memory card or Control Unit.

F01050.cause:
The memory card and the device type do not match (e.g. a memory card for SINAMICS S is inserted in SINAMICS
G).
F01050.action:
- insert the matching memory card.
- use the matching Control Unit or power unit.

F01054.cause:
A system overload was identified as a result of too many functions requiring a lot of computation time.
At least one of the following rules was not complied with:
- it is not permissible to activate function module "Closed-loop position control" (r0108.3) in conjunction with "Free
function blocks" (r0108.18).
- it is not permissible to activate function module "Basic positioner" (r0108.4) in conjunction with "Free function
blocks" (r0108.18).
- when the function module "Free function blocks" is activated (r0108.18), only 1 speed encoder must be operated.
F01054.action: Configure the drive device corresponding to the rules listed under cause.

F01068.description: CU: Data memo ry memory overflow
F01068.cause: The utilization for a data memory area is too large.
F01068.action:
- de-activate the function module.
- de-activate drive object.
- remove the drive object from the target topology.

F01072.description: Memory card restored from the backup copy
F01072.cause:
The Control Unit was switched-off while writing to the memory card. This is why the visible partition became defective.
After switching on, the data from the non-visible partition (backup copy) were written to the visible partition.
F01072.action: Check that the firmware and parameterization is up-to-date.

F01105.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Too many data sets are configured on this Control Unit.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Too many functions have been configured on this Control Unit (e.g. too many drives, function modules, data sets,
OA applications, blocks, etc).
F01105.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- reduce the number of data sets.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- change the configuration on this Control Unit (e.g. fewer drives, function modules, data sets, OA applications,
blocks, etc).
- use an additional Control Unit.

F01107.description: CU: Data save in the non-volatile memory unsuccessful / Save to memory card unsuccessful
F01107.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
A data save to the memory card was not able to be successfully carried out.
- Memory card is defective.
- Insufficient space on memory card.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
A data save in the non-volatile memory was not able to be successfully carried out.
- non-volatile memory is defective.
- insufficient space in the non-volatile memory.
F01107.action:
- try to save again.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.

F01110.description: CU: More than one SINA MICS G on one Control Unit
F01110.cause: More than one SINAMICS G type power unit is being operated from the Control Unit.
F01110.action: Only one SINAMICS G drive type is permitted.

F01111.description: CU: Mixed operation of drive units illegal
F01111.cause:
Illegal operation of various drive units on one Control Unit:
- SINAMICS S together with SINAMICS G
- SINAMICS S together with SINAMICS S Value or Combi
F01111.action: Only power units of one particular drive type may be operated with one Control Unit.

F01112.cause: The connected power unit cannot be used together with this Control Unit.
F01112.action: Replace the power unit that is not permissible by a component that is permissible.

F01120.cause: An internal software error occurred while the terminal functions were being initialized.
F01120.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.
- replace the Control Unit.

F01122.description: Frequency at the measuring probe input too high
F01122.cause: The frequency of the pulses at the measuring probe input is too high.
F01122.action: Reduce the frequency of the pulses at the measuring probe input.

F01150.description: CU: Number of instances of a drive object type exceeded
F01150.cause:
The maximum permissible number of instances of a drive object type was exceeded.
Drive object type:
Drive object type (p0107), for which the maximum permissible number of instances was exceeded.
Number permitted:
Max. permissible number of instances for this drive object type.
Actual number:
Current number of instances for this drive object type.
Note regarding the message value:
The individual information is coded as follows in the message value (r0949/r2124):
ddccbbaa hex: aa = drive object type, bb = number limited, cc = actual number, dd = no significance
F01150.action:
- power down the unit.
- suitably restrict the number of instances of a drive object type by reducing the number of inserted components.
- re-commission the unit.

F01151.description: CU: Number of drive objects of a category exceeded
F01151.cause:
The maximum permissible number of drive objects of a category was exceeded.
Drive object category:
Drive object category, for which the maximum permissible number of drive objects was exceeded.
Number permitted:
Max. permissible number for this drive object category.
Actual number:
Actual number for this drive object category.
Note regarding the message value:
The individual information is coded as follows in the message value (r0949/r2124):
ddccbbaa hex: aa = drive object category, bb = number limited, cc = actual number, dd = no significance
F01151.action:
- power down the unit.
- suitably restrict the number of drive objects of the specified category by reducing the number of inserted components.
- re-commission the unit.

F01200.description: CU: Time slice management internal software error
F01200.cause:
A time slice management error has occurred.
It is possible that the sampling times have been inadmissibly set.
F01200.action:
- check the sampling time setting (p0112, p0115, p4099, p9500, p9511).
- contact the Hotline.

F01205.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Insufficient computation time.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Insufficient processing time is available for the existing topology.
F01205.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Contact the Hotline.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- reduce the number of drives.
- increase the sampling times.

F01221.description: CU: Bas clk cyc too low
F01221.cause:
The closed-loop control / monitoring cannot maintain the envisaged clock cycle.
The runtime of the closed-loop control/monitoring is too long for the particular clock cycle or the computing time
remaining in the system is not sufficient for the closed-loop control/monitoring.
F01221.action: Increase the basic clock cycle of DRIVE-CLiQ communication.

F01250.cause: Error when reading the read-only data of the EEPROM in the Control Unit.
F01250.action:
- carry out a POWER ON.
- replace the Control Unit.

F01255.description: CU: Option Board EEPROM read-only data error
F01255.cause: Error when reading the read-only data of the EEPROM in the Option Board.
F01255.action:
- carry out a POWER ON.
- replace the Control Unit.

F01303.description: DRIVE-CLiQ component does not support the required function
F01303.cause: A function requested by the Control Unit is not supported by a DRIVE-CLiQ component.
F01303.action:
Upgrade the firmware of the DRIVE-CLiQ component involved.
For fault value = 205:
Check parameter p0600 and p0601 and if required, adapt interpretation.
For fault value = 207:
Replace the power unit or if required set the device supply voltage higher (p0210).
For fault value = 208:
Check parameter p0430.23 and reset if necessary.

F01305.cause:
The component number from the topology was not parameterized (p0121 (for power unit, refer to p0107), p0131 (for
servo/vector drives, refer to p0107), p0141, p0151, p0161).
F01305.action: Enter the missing component number or remove the component and restart commissioning.
F01305.note:
The fault also occurs if speed encoders have been configured (p0187 to p0189) but no component numbers exist for
them.
In this case, the fault value includes the drive data set number plus 100 * encoder number (e.g. 3xx, if a component
number was not entered in p0141 for the third encoder (p0189)).

F01325.description: Topology: Component number not present in target topology
F01325.cause: The component configured in a parameter (e.g. p0121, p0131, etc.) is not present in the target topology.
F01325.action: Establish topology and DO configuration consistency.

F01340.description: Topology: Too many components on one line
F01340.cause:
For the selected communications clock cycle, too many DRIVE-CLiQ components are connected to one line of the
Control Unit.
F01340.action:
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- Reduce the number of components on the DRIVE-CLiQ line involved and distribute these to other DRIVE-CLiQ
sockets of the Control Unit. This means that communication is uniformly distributed over several lines.
Re fault value = 1yy - 4yy in addition:
- increase the sampling times (p0112, p0115, p4099). If necessary, for DCC or FBLOCKS, change the assignment
of the run-time group (p21000, p20000) so that the sampling time (r21001, r20001) is increased.
- if necessary, reduce the number of cyclically calculated blocks (DCC) and/or function blocks (FBLOCKS).
- reduce the function modules (r0108).
- establish the conditions for operation with a current controller sampling time of 31.25 µs (at the DRIVE-CLiQ line,
only operate Motor Modules and Sensor Modules with this sampling time and only use a permitted Sensor Module
(e.g. SMC20, this means a 3 at the last position of the order number)).
- For an NX, the corresponding Sensor Module for a possibly existing second measuring system should be connected to a free DRIVE-CLiQ socket of the NX.
Re fault value = 8yy in addition:
- check the clock cycles settings (p0112, p0115, p4099). Clock cycles on a DRIVE-CLiQ line must be perfect integer
multiples of one another. As clock cycle on a line, all clock cycles of all drive objects in the previously mentioned
parameters apply, which have components on the line involved.
Re fault value = 9yy in addition:
- check the clock cycles settings (p0112, p0115, p4099). The lower the numerical value difference between two clock
cycles, the higher the lowest common multiple. This behavior has a significantly stronger influence, the higher the
numerical values of the clock cycles.

F01341.description: Topology: Maximum number of DRIVE-CLiQ components exceeded
F01341.cause: Too many DRIVE-CLiQ components were defined in the actual topology.
F01341.action:
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- reduce the number components on the DRIVE-CLiQ line involved in order to maintain the maximum quantity structure.
F01341.note: Pulse enable is withdrawn and prevented.

F01354.description: Topology: Actual topology indicates an illegal component
F01354.cause: The actual topology indicates at least one illegal component.
F01354.action: Remove the illegal components and restart the system.

F01355.cause:
The device target topology (p0099) does not correspond to the device actual topology (r0098).
The fault only occurs if the topology was commissioned using the automatic internal device mechanism and not using
the commissioning software.
F01355.action:
One of the following counter-measures can be selected if no faults have occurred in the topology detection itself:
If commissioning is still not completed:
- carry out a self-commissioning routine (starting from p0009 = 1).
In general:
Set p0099 = r0098, set p0009 = 0; for existing Motor Modules, this results in servo drives being automatically generated (p0107).
Generating servo drives: Set p0097 to 1, set p0009 to 0.
Generating vector drives: Set p0097 to 2, set p0009 to 0.
Generating vector drives with parallel circuit: Set p0097 to 12, set p0009 to 0.
In order to set configurations in p0108, before setting p0009 to 0, it is possible to first set p0009 to 2 and modify
p0108. The index corresponds to the drive object (p0107).
If commissioning has already been completed:
- re-establish the original connections and re-connect power to the Control Unit.
- restore the factory setting for the complete equipment (all of the drives) and allow automatic self-commissioning
again.
- change the device parameterization to match the connections (this is only possible using the commissioning software).

F01356.description: Topology: There is a defective DRIVE-CLiQ component
F01356.cause: The actual topology indicates at least one defective DRIVE-CLiQ component.
F01356.action: Replace the defective component and restart the system.
F01356.note: Pulse enable is withdrawn and prevented.

F01357.description: Topology: Two Control Units identified on the DRIVE-CLiQ line
F01357.cause: In the actual topology, 2 Control Units are connected with one another through DRIVE-CLiQ. This is not permitted.
F01357.action:
- remove the second Control Unit and restart the system.
- for the component DRIVE-CLiQ extension, interchange the hybrid cable (IN/OUT).
F01357.note: Pulse enable is withdrawn and prevented.

F01359.cause: The DRIVE-CLiQ performance is not sufficient at one line in order to identify an inserted component.
F01359.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- Distribute components across several DRIVE-CLiQ lines.
F01359.note: For this topology, do not withdraw and insert components in operation.

F01360.cause: The detected actual topology is not permissible.
F01360.action:
Re fault cause = 1:
Change the configuration. Connect less than 199 components to the Control Unit.
Re fault cause = 2:
Remove the component with unknown component type.
Re fault cause = 3, 4, 5:
Establish a valid combination.
Re fault cause = 6, 7:
Connect the expansion module directly to a permitted Control Unit.
Re fault cause = 8:
Remove component or use a permissible component.
Re fault cause = 9:
Upgrade the firmware of the Control Unit to a later version.
Re fault cause = 10, 11:
Reduce the number of components.
F01360.note: The drive system is no longer booted. In this state, the drive control (closed-loop) cannot be enabled.

F01375.description: Topology: Actual topol ogy, duplicate connection between two components
F01375.cause: When detecting the actual topology, a ring-type connection was detected.
F01375.action: Output the fault value and remove the specified connection.
F01375.note: Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

F01380.description: Topology: Actual t opology, defective EEPROM
F01380.cause: When detecting the actual topology, a component with a defective EEPROM was detected.
F01380.action: Output the fault value and remove the defected component.

F01451.cause:
An error was detected in the target topology.
The target topology is invalid.
F01451.action: Reload the target topology using the commissioning software.

F01470.cause: A ring-type connection was detected when writing to the target topology.
F01470.action:
Read out the fault value and remove one of the specified connections.
Then download the target topology again using the commissioning software.
F01470.note:
Component class and connection number are described in F01375.
Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

F01475.description: Topology: Target topology duplicate connection between two components
F01475.cause: When writing the target topology, a duplicate connection between two components was detected.
F01475.action:
Read out the fault value and remove one of the two specified connections.
Then download the target topology again using the commissioning software.
F01475.note:
Component class and connection number are described in F01375.
Under "Topology --> Topology view" the commissioning software where relevant offers improved diagnostics capability (e.g. setpoint/actual value comparison).

F01505.cause:
A PROFIdrive telegram has been set (p0922).
An interconnection contained in the telegram was not able to be established.

F01510.description: BICO: Signal source is not float type
F01510.cause: The requested connector output does not have the correct data type. This interconnection is not established.
F01510.action: Interconnect this connector input with a connector output having a float data type.

F01511.cause:
The requested BICO interconnection was established. However, a conversion is made between the BICO output and
BICO input using the reference values.
- the BICO output has different normalized units than the BICO input.
- message only for interconnections within a drive object.
Example:
The BICO output has, as normalized unit, voltage and the BICO input has current.
This means that the factor p2002/p2001 is calculated between the BICO output and the BICO input.
p2002: contains the reference value for current
p2001: contains the reference value for voltage

F01512.cause: An attempt was made to determine a conversion factor for a scaling that does not exist.
F01512.action: Apply scaling or check the transfer value.

F01513.description: BICO: Interconnection cross DO with different scalings
F01513.cause:
The requested BICO interconnection was established. However, a conversion is made between the BICO output and
BICO input using the reference values.
An interconnection is made between different drive objects and the BICO output has different normalized units than
the BICO input or the normalized units are the same but the reference values are different.
Example 1:
BICO output with voltage normalized unit, BICO input with current normalized unit, BICO output and BICO input lie
in different drive objects. This means that the factor p2002/p2001 is calculated between the BICO output and the
BICO input.
p2002: contains the reference value for current
p2001: contains the reference value for voltage
Example 2:
BICO output with voltage normalized unit in drive object 1 (DO1), BICO input with voltage normalized unit in drive
object 2 (DO2). The reference values for voltage (p2001) of the two drive objects have different values. This means
that the factor p2001(DO1)/p2001(DO2) is calculated between the BICO output and the BICO input.
p2001: contains the reference value for voltage, drive objects 1, 2

F01515.description: BICO: Writing to parameter not permitted as the master control is active
F01515.cause: When changing the number of CDS or when copying from CDS, the master control is active.
F01515.action: If required, return the master control and repeat the operation.

F01600.cause:
The drive-integrated "Safety Integrated" function on processor 1 has detected an error and initiated a STOP A.
- forced checking procedure of the safety shutdown path on processor 1 unsuccessful.
- subsequent response to fault F01611 (defect in a monitoring channel).
F01600.action:
- select Safe Torque Off and de-select again.
For fault value = 9999:
- carry out diagnostics for fault F01611.

F01611.description: SI P1: Defect in a monitoring channel
F01611.cause:
The drive-integrated "Safety Integrated" function on processor 1 has detected a fault in the crosswise data comparison between the two monitoring channels and has initiated a STOP F.
Fault F01600 (SI P1: STOP A initiated) is output as a consequence of this fault.
F01611.action:
Re fault values 1 ... 999 described in "Cause":
- check the cross data comparison that resulted in a STOP F.
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
For fault value = 1000:
- check the wiring of the F-DI (contact problems).
- PROFIsafe: Remove contact problems/faults at the PROFIBUS master/PROFINET controller.
Re fault value = 1001, 1002:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
Re fault value = 2000, 2001, 2003:
- check the tolerance time F-DI changeover and if required, increase the value (p9650/p9850).
- check the wiring of the F-DI (contact problems).
- check the causes of the STO selection in r9772. When the SI Motion functions are active (p9501 = 1), STO can
also be selected using these functions.
For fault value = 6000:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.
- replace Control Unit.
For fault value = 6064:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_Dest_Add at the PROFIsafe slave.
- check the setting of the PROFIsafe address on processor 1 (p9610) and on processor 2 (p9810).
For fault value = 6065:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_Dest_Add at the PROFIsafe slave. It is not permissible for the
destination address to be either 0 or FFFF!
For fault value = 6066:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_Source_Add at the PROFIsafe slave. It is not permissible for
the source address to be either 0 or FFFF!
For fault value = 6067:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_WD_Time at the PROFIsafe slave. It is not permissible for the
watch time to be 0!
For fault value = 6068:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_SIL at the PROFIsafe slave. The SIL level must correspond to
SIL2!
For fault value = 6069:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_CRC_Length at the PROFIsafe slave. The setting of the CRC2
length is 2-byte CRC in the V1 mode and 3-byte CRC in the V2 mode!
For fault value = 6070:
- check the setting of the value in the F parameter F_Par_Version at the PROFIsafe slave. The value for the F parameter version is 0 in the V1 mode and 1 in the V2 mode!
For fault value = 6071:
- check the settings of the values of the F parameters and the F parameter CRC (CRC1) calculated from these at
the PROFIsafe slave and, if required, update.
For fault value = 6072:
- check the settings of the values for the F parameters and, if required, correct.
The following combinations are permissible for F parameters F_CRC_Length and F_Par_Version:
F_CRC_Length = 2-byte CRC and F_Par_Version = 0
F_CRC_Length = 3-byte CRC and F_Par_Version = 1
For fault value = 6165:
- if the fault occurs after powering up or after inserting the PROFIBUS/PROFINET cable, acknowledge the fault.
- check the configuration and communication at the PROFIsafe slave.
- check the setting of the value for F parameter F_WD_Time on the PROFIsafe slave and increase if necessary.
For fault value = 6166:
- check the configuration and communication at the PROFIsafe slave.
- check the setting of the value for F parameter F_WD_Time on the PROFIsafe slave and increase if necessary.
- evaluate diagnostic information in the F host.
- check PROFIsafe connection.
Re fault values that are described in "Cause":
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- contact the Hotline.
- replace Control Unit.
F01611.note:
F-DI: Failsafe Digital Input
STO: Safe Torque Off

F01625.description: SI P1: Sign-of-life error in safety data
F01625.cause:
The drive-integrated "Safety Integrated" function on processor 1 has detected an error in the sign-of-life of the safety
data and initiated a STOP A.
- there is a communication error between processor 1 and processor 2 or communication has failed.
- a time slice overflow of the safety software has occurred.
F01625.action:
- select Safe Torque Off and de-select again.
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- check whether additional faults are present and if required, perform diagnostics.
- check the electrical cabinet design and cable routing for EMC compliance

F01630.cause:
The "Safety Integrated" function integrated in the drive on processor 1 (P1) has detected a brake control error and
initiated a STOP A.
- motor cable is not shielded correctly.
- defect in the Safe Brake Module, in the Power Module or in the Control Unit.
F01630.action:
- check parameter p1278 (for SBC, only p1278 = 0 is permissible).
- select Safe Torque Off and de-select again.
- check the motor holding brake connection.
- check the function of the motor holding brake.
- check the Safe Brake Module connection.
- check that the electrical cabinet design and cable routing are in compliance with EMC regulations (e.g. shield of the
motor cable and brake conductors are connected with the shield connecting plate and the motor connectors are
tightly screwed to the housing).
- replace the Safe Brake Module.
- replace Power Module.
- replace the Control Unit.
F01630.note:
SBC: Safe Brake Control
SI: Safety Integrated

F01649.cause: An internal error in the Safety Integrated software on processor 1 has occurred.
F01649.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- re-commission the "Safety Integrated" function and carry out a POWER ON.
- contact the Hotline.
- replace Control Unit.
F01649.note: This fault results in a STOP A that cannot be acknowledged.

F01650.cause: The drive-integrated "Safety Integrated" function on processor 1 requires an acceptance test.
F01650.action:
For fault value = 130:
- carry out safety commissioning routine.
For fault value = 1000:
- again carry out safety commissioning routine.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.
- Using STARTER, activate the safety parameters for the drive involved (change settings, copy parameters, activate
settings).
For fault value = 2000:
- check the safety parameters on processor 1 and adapt the reference checksum (p9799).
For fault value = 2001:
- check the safety parameters on processor 2 and adapt the reference checksum (p9899).
For fault value = 2002:
- enable the safety-related functions on processor 1 and check processor 2 (p9601 = p9801).
Re fault value = 2003, 2004, 2005:
- Carry out an acceptance test and generate an acceptance report.
The fault with fault value 2005 can only be acknowledged when the "STO" function is de-selected.
For fault value = 2020:
- again carry out safety commissioning routine.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.
For fault value = 9999:
- carry out diagnostics for the other safety-related fault that is present.
F01650.note:
This fault results in a STOP A that can be acknowledged.
This fault value is always output when Safety Integrated is commissioned for the first time.
1000: Reference and actual checksum on processor 1 are not identical (booting).
- at least one checksum-checked piece of data is defective.
- Safety parameters set offline and loaded into the Control Unit.
2000: Reference and actual checksum on processor 1 are not identical (commissioning mode).
- reference checksum incorrectly entered on processor 1 (p9799 not equal to r9798).
- when de-activating the safety functions, p9501 was not deleted.
2001: Reference and actual checksum on processor 2 are not identical (commissioning mode).
- reference checksum incorrectly entered on processor 2 (p9899 not equal to r9898).
- when de-activating the safety functions, p9501 was not deleted.
2002: Enable of safety-related functions between the processor 1 and processor 2 differ (p9601 not equal to p9801).
2003: Acceptance test is required as a safety parameter has been changed.
2004: An acceptance test is required because a project with enabled safety-functions has been downloaded.
2005: The Safety logbook has identified that a functional safety checksum has changed. An acceptance test is
required.
2020: Error when saving the safety parameters for the processor 2.
9999: Subsequent response of another safety-related fault that occurred when booting that requires an acceptance
test.
STO: Safe Torque Off

F01651.description: SI P1: Synchronization safety time slices unsuccessful
F01651.cause: The "Safety Integrated" function requires synchronization of the safety time slices between processor 1 and processor 2. This synchronization was unsuccessful.
F01651.action: Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
F01651.note: This fault results in a STOP A that cannot be acknowledged.

F01653.cause: There is a PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration error for using Safety Integrated monitoring functions with a higherlevel control.
F01653.action:
The following generally applies:
- check and, if necessary, correct the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration of the safety slot on the master side.
- upgrade the Control Unit software.
For fault value = 250:
- remove the PROFIsafe configuring in the higher-level F control or enable PROFIsafe in the drive.
Re fault value = 231, 331:
- configure the PROFIsafe telegram matching the parameterization in the F-PLC.
The following applies for p9501.30 = 1 (F-DI via PROFIsafe is enabled):
- PROFIsafe telegram 900 must be configured.
For p9501.30 = 0 (F-DI not enabled via PROFIsafe), the following applies:
- PROFIsafe telegram 30 must be configured.
F01653.note: For safety functions that have been enabled, this fault results in a STOP A that cannot be acknowledged.

F01655.cause:
An error has occurred when aligning the Safety Integrated monitoring functions on processor 1 and processor 2. No
common set of supported SI monitoring functions was able to be determined.
- there is a communication error between processor 1 and processor 2 or communication has failed.
F01655.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- check the electrical cabinet design and cable routing for EMC compliance
F01655.note: This fault results in a STOP A that cannot be acknowledged.

F01656.description: SI P1: Parameter proc essor 2 parameter error
F01656.cause:
When accessing the Safety Integrated parameters for the processor 2 in the non-volatile memory, an error has
occurred.
F01656.action:
- re-commission the safety functions.
- replace the memory card or Control Unit.
For fault value = 129:
- activate the safety commissioning mode (p0010 = 95).
- adapt the PROFIsafe address (p9610).
- start the copy function for SI parameters (p9700 = D0 hex).
- acknowledge data change (p9701 = DC hex).
- exit the safety commissioning mode (p0010 = 0).
- save all parameters (p0971 = 1 or "copy RAM to ROM").
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for the Control Unit.
For fault value = 132:
- check the electrical cabinet design and cable routing for EMC compliance
F01656.note: This fault results in a STOP A that can be acknowledged.

F01658.description: SI P1: PROFIsafe telegram number not suitable
F01658.cause:
The PROFIsafe telegram number in p60022 is unsuitable for the enabled safety functions.
Possible causes:
- When PROFIsafe is not enabled (p9601.3 = 0), then it is not permissible to select a PROFIsafe telegram in p60022.
- When PROFIsafe is enabled (p9601.3 = 1), then a PROFIsafe telegram must be selected in p60022.
- When the transfer of the F-DIs via PROFIsafe (p9501.30 = 1) is selected, then telegram 900 must be selected in
p60022 (this only applies to Control Units, which support Extended Functions via PROFIsafe (r9771.4 = 1)).
F01658.action: Select the telegram number that matches the Safety functions that have been enabled.
F01658.note: This fault does not result in a safety stop response.

F01659.description: SI P1: Write request  for parameter rejected
F01659.cause: The write request for one or several Safety Integrated parameters on processor 1 was rejected.
F01659.action:
For fault value = 1:
- set the Safety Integrated password (p9761).
For fault value = 2:
- Inhibit Safety Integrated (p9501, p9601) or reset safety parameters (p0970 = 5), then reset the drive parameters
again.
For fault value = 3:
- end the simulation mode for the digital input (p0795).
Re fault value = 10, 14, 15, 18, 20:
- check whether there are faults in the safety function alignment (F01655, F30655) and if required, carry out diagnostics for the faults involved.
- use a Control Unit that supports the required function.
For fault value = 21:
- use a Power Module that supports the Safety Integrated functions.
For fault value = 26:
- check whether p10049 is set. Also check p10006 and p10009. Check whether in p10046, p10047
a test top of the FDO with a read back input is parameterized.
F01659.note:
This fault does not result in a safety stop response.
STO: Safe Torque Off

F01660.description: SI P1: Safety-related functions not supported
F01660.cause: The Power Module does not support the safety-related functions. Safety Integrated cannot be commissioned.
F01660.action: - use a Power Module that supports the safety-related functions.
F01660.note: This fault does not result in a safety stop response.

F01661.description: SI P1: Simulation of the safety inputs active
F01661.cause:
The simulation of the digital inputs of the Control Unit (p0795) is active.
It is not permissible that safety inputs are simulated.
F01661.action:
- Deactivate the simulation of the digital inputs of the Control Unit for the safety inputs (p0795).
- acknowledge fault.

F01662.cause: A module-internal communication error has occurred.
F01662.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.

F01663.description: SI P1: Copying the SI parameters rejected
F01663.cause:
One of the following values is saved in p9700 or was entered offline: 87 or 208.
This is the reason that when booting, an attempt is made to copy SI parameters from processor 1 to processor 2.
However, no safety-relevant function has been selected on processor 1 (p9501 = 0, p9601 = 0). This is the reason
that copying is not possible.
F01663.action:
- Set p9700 to 0.
- Check p9501 and/or p9601 and if required, correct.
- Restart the copying function by entering the corresponding value into p9700.
F01663.note: This fault does not result in a safety stop response.

F01665.cause: A system defect was detected before the last boot or in the actual one. The system might have been rebooted (reset).
F01665.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on).
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.
Re fault value = 200000 hex, 400000 hex, 8000yy hex (yy any):
- ensure that the Control Unit is connected to the Power Module.

F01680.description: SI Motion P1: Checksum error safety monitoring functions
F01680.cause:
The actual checksum calculated by the drive and entered in r9728 via the safety-relevant parameters does not match
the reference checksum saved in p9729 at the last machine acceptance.
Safety-relevant parameters have been changed or a fault is present.
F01680.action:
- check the safety-relevant parameters and if required, correct.
- execute the function "Copy RAM to ROM".
- perform a POWER ON if safety parameters requiring a POWER ON have been modified.
- carry out an acceptance test.
F01680.note: This fault results in a STOP A that can be acknowledged.

F01681.description: SI Motion P1: Incorrect parameter value
F01681.cause: The parameter cannot be parameterized with this value.
F01681.action:
Correct the parameter value.
If xxxx = 9547:
With hysteresis/filtering enabled (p9501.16 = 1), the following applies:
Set parameters p9546/p9346 and p9547/p9347 acc. to the following rule: p9546 >= 2 x p9547; p9346 >= 2 x p9347
If xxxx = 9522 and 9585:
Correct parameters.
F01681.note: This fault does not result in a safety stop response.

F01682.description: SI Motion P1: Monitoring function not supported
F01682.cause: The monitoring function enabled in p9501, p9601 or p9801 is not supported in this firmware version.
F01682.action: De-select the monitoring function involved (p9501, p9601, p9801).
F01682.note:
This fault results in a STOP A that cannot be acknowledged.
SCA: Safe Cam
SDI: Safe Direction
SLP: Safely-Limited Position
SLS: Safely-Limited Speed

F01683.description: SI Motion P1: SLS enable missing
F01683.cause:
The safety-relevant function "SLS" is not enabled in p9501 although other safety-relevant monitoring functions are
enabled.
F01683.action: Enable the function "SLS" (p9501.0) and carry out a POWER ON.
F01683.note:
This fault does not result in a safety stop response.
Save the changes before POWER ON (copy from RAM to ROM).
SLS: Safely-Limited Speed

F01690.description: SI Motion: Data save problem for the NVRAM
F01690.cause: There is not sufficient memory space in the NVRAM on the drive to save parameters r9781 and r9782 (safety logbook).
F01690.action:
For fault value = 0:
- use a Control Unit NVRAM.
For fault value = 1:
- de-select functions that are not required and that take up memory space in the NVRAM.
- contact the Hotline.
F01690.note:
This fault does not result in a safety stop response.
NVRAM: Non-Volatile Random Access Memory (non-volatile read and write memory)

F01692.description: SI Motion P1: Parameter value not permitted for encoderless
F01692.cause: For encoderless motion monitoring functions, the parameter cannot be parameterized with this value.
F01692.action: Correct the parameter specified in the fault value.
F01692.note: This fault does not result in a safety stop response.

F01773.description: SI Motion P1: Test stop error
F01773.cause: A fault has occurred on processor 1 (P1) during the test stop for the fail-safe outputs.
F01773.action: Check the wiring of the F-DOs and restart the test stop.
F01773.note:
The fault is withdrawn if the test stop is successfully completed.
In the event of multiple test stop faults, the first one that occurred is shown.
Once the test stop has been restarted the next queued test stop fault will be signaled (if there is one).

F01800.cause: A DRIVE-CLiQ connection fault has occurred.
F01800.action:
Re fault value = 100 ... 107:
- ensure that the DRIVE-CLiQ components have the same firmware versions.
- avoid longer topologies for short current controller clock cycles.
For fault value = 10:
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ cables at the Control Unit.
- remove any short-circuit for motors with DRIVE-CLiQ.
- carry out a POWER ON.
For fault value = 11:
- check the electrical cabinet design and cable routing for EMC compliance
For fault value = 12:
- replace the component involved.

F01910.description: Fieldbus interface setpoint timeout / Fieldbus: setpoint timeout
F01910.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The reception of setpoints from the fieldbus interface has been interrupted.
- bus connection interrupted.
- communication partner switched off.
For PROFIBUS:
- PROFIBUS master set into the STOP state.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The reception of setpoints from the fieldbus interface (onboard, PROFIBUS/PROFINET/USS) has been interrupted.
- bus connection interrupted.
- controller switched off.
- controller set into the STOP state.
F01910.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Ensure bus connection has been established and switch on communication peer.
- if required, adapt p2040.
For PROFIBUS:
- set the PROFIBUS master to the RUN state.
- slave redundancy: For operation on a Y link, it must be ensured that "DP alarm mode = DPV1" is set in the slave
parameterization.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
Restore the bus connection and set the controller to RUN.
PROFIBUS slave redundancy:
For operation on a Y link, it must be ensured that "DP alarm mode = DPV1" is set in the slave parameterization.

F01911.description: PB/PN clock cycle synchronous operation clock cycle failure
F01911.cause:
The global control telegram to synchronize the clock cycles has failed - in cyclic operation - for several DP clock
cycles or has violated the time grid specified in the parameterizing telegram over several consecutive DP clock
cycles (refer to the bus cycle time, Tdp and Tpllw).
F01911.action:
- check the physical bus configuration (cable, connector, terminating resistor, shielding, etc.).
- check whether communication was briefly or permanently interrupted.
- check the bus and controller for utilization level (e.g. bus cycle time Tdp was set too short).
PB: PROFIBUS
PN: PROFINET

F01912.description: PB/PN clock cycle synchronous operation sign-of-life failure
F01912.cause:
The maximum permissible number of errors in the controller sign-of-life (clock synchronous operation) has been
exceeded in cyclic operation.
F01912.action:
- physically check the bus (cables, connectors, terminating resistor, shielding, etc.).
- correct the interconnection of the controller sign-of-life (p2045).
- check whether the controller correctly sends the sign-of-life (e.g. create a trace with STW2.12 ... STW2.15 and trigger signal ZSW1.3).
- check the permissible telegram failure rate (p0925).
- check the bus and controller for utilization level (e.g. bus cycle time Tdp was set too short).

F01946.description: PROFIBUS: Connection to the Publisher aborted
F01946.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The connection to at least one Publisher for PROFIBUS peer-to-peer data transfer in cyclic operation has been
aborted.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
At this drive object, the connection to at least one Publisher for PROFIBUS peer-to-peer data transfer in cyclic operation has been aborted.
F01946.action:
- check the PROFIBUS cables.
- check the state of the Publisher that has the aborted connection.

F01950.description: PB/PN clock cycle synchronous operation synchronization unsuccessful
F01950.cause:
Synchronization of the internal clock cycle to the global control telegram has failed. The internal clock cycle exhibits
an unexpected shift.

F01951.description: CU DRIVE-CLiQ: Synchronization application clock cycle missing / CU SYNC: Synchronization application clock cycle missing
F01951.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
Internal synchronization of the application cycles unsuccessful.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
If DRIVE-CLiQ components with different application clock cycle are operated on a DRIVE-CLiQ port, this requires
synchronization with the Control Unit. This synchronization routine was unsuccessful.
F01951.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade the Control Unit software.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade the software of the DRIVE-CLiQ components.
- upgrade the Control Unit software.
F01951.note:
If a Controller Extension is being used (e.g. CX32, NX10), then the following applies:
Check whether the Controller Extension is issuing error messages, and if required, remove these.

F01952.description: CU DRIVE-CLiQ: Synchronization of component not supported
F01952.cause:
The existing system configuration requires that the connected DRIVE-CLiQ components support the synchronization
between the basic clock cycle, DRIVE-CLiQ clock cycle and the application clock cycle.
However, not all DRIVE-CLiQ components have this functionality.
F01952.action: Upgrade the firmware of the component specified in the fault value.
F01952.note: If required, also upgrade additional components in the DRIVE-CLiQ line.

F01954.cause:
Synchronization between the basic clock cycle, DRIVE-CLiQ clock cycle and application clock cycle was started and
was not able to be successfully completed (e.g. after switch-on).
F01954.action:
1. Remove the cause of a possible DRIVE-CLiQ fault.
2. Initiate a new synchronization, e.g. as follows:
- remove the PROFIBUS master and re-insert again.
- restart the PROFIBUS master.
- switch-off the Control Unit and switch-on again.
- carry out a Control Unit hardware reset (RESET button, p0972).
- carry out a parameter reset and download the saved parameters (p0009 = 30, p0976 = 2, 3).

F02080.description: Trace: Parameterization deleted due to unit changeover
F02080.cause:
The trace parameterization in the drive unit was deleted due to a unit changeover or a change in the reference
parameters.

F02151.cause: An internal software error has occurred within an OA application.
F02151.action:
- carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.
- upgrade firmware to later version.
- contact the Hotline.
- replace the Control Unit.

F02152.cause:
Too many functions have been configured on this Control Unit (e.g. too many drives, function modules, data sets,
OA applications, blocks, etc).
F02152.action:
- change the configuration on this Control Unit (e.g. fewer drives, function modules, data sets, OA applications,
blocks, etc).
- use an additional Control Unit.

F03000.cause: A fault occurred during execution of action p7770 = 1 or 2 for the NVRAM data.
F03000.action:
- Perform the remedy according to the results of the troubleshooting.
- If necessary, start the action again.

F03001.cause:
A checksum error occurred when evaluating the non-volatile data (NVRAM) on the Control Unit.
The NVRAM data affected was deleted.
F03001.action: Carry out a POWER ON (power off/on) for all components.

F03500.cause: When initializing the Terminal Modules, the terminals of the Control Unit or the Terminal Board 30, an internal software error has occurred.
F03500.action:
- power down/power up the power supply for the Control Unit.
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- if required, replace the Terminal Module.
The Terminal Module should be directly connected to a DRIVE-CLiQ socket of the Control Unit.
If the fault occurs again, replace the Terminal Module.

F03505.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The wire-break monitoring for an analog input has responded.
The input current of the analog input has undershot the threshold value parameterized in p0761[0...1]. p0756[0]: analog input 0 (terminal 3/4)
p0756[1]: analog input 1 (terminal 10/11)

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The wire-break monitoring for an analog input has responded.
The input current of the analog input has undershot the threshold value parameterized in p0761[0...1].
p0756[0]: analog input 0 (terminal 3/4)
p0756[1]: analog input 1 (terminal 10/11)
F03505.action:
- Check the wiring to the signal source for interruptions.
- Check the magnitude of the injected current - it is possible that the infed signal is too low.
- Check the load resistor (250 Ohm).
F03505.note:
For the following analog input type, the wire breakage monitoring is active:
p0756[0...1] = 3 (4 ... 20 mA with monitoring)A)
The input current measured by the analog input can be read in r0752[0].
For p756[0...1] = 3 (unipolar current input monitored (+4 ... +20 mA)) the following applies:
A current less than 4 mA is not displayed in r752[0...1] - but instead r752[0...1] = 4 mA is output.

F03590.cause: The Terminal Module involved does not send a ready signal and no valid cyclic data.
F03590.action:
- check the 24 V power supply.
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- check whether the sampling time of the drive object involved is not equal to zero (p4099[0]).

F05118.description: Pre-charging contactor simultaneity monitoring time exceeded
F05118.cause:
A feedback signal for the pre-charging contactor (ALM, SLM, BLM diode) or the line contactor (BLM thyristor) interconnected and the simultaneity monitoring (p0255[4, 6]) activated.
After opening or closing a contactor of the parallel connection, after a monitoring time has elapsed, not all of the contactors have assumed the same state.
F05118.action:
- check the monitoring time setting (p0255[4, 6]).
- check the contactor wiring and activation.
- if required, replace the contactor.

F05119.description: Bypass contactor simultaneity monitoring time exceeded
F05119.cause:
A feedback signal for the bypass contactor is interconnected and the simultaneity monitoring (p0255[5, 7]) activated.
After opening or closing a contactor of the parallel connection, after a monitoring time has elapsed, not all of the contactors have assumed the same state.
F05119.action:
- check the monitoring time setting (p0255[5, 7]).
- check the contactor wiring and activation.
- if required, replace the contactor.

F06310.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The measured DC voltage lies outside the tolerance range after pre-charging has been completed.
The following applies for the tolerance range: 1.16 * p0210 < r0070 < 1.6 * p0210

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
For AC/AC drive units, the measured DC voltage lies outside the tolerance range after pre-charging has been completed.
The following applies for the tolerance range: 1.16 * p0210 < r0070 < 1.6 * p0210
F06310.action:
- check the parameterized supply voltage and if required change (p0210).
- check the line supply voltage.
F06310.note: The fault can only be acknowledged when the drive is powered down.

F06922.cause: A phase failure for the brake resistor was detected.
F06922.action: Check the feeder cables to the braking resistors.

F07011.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
KTY:
The motor temperature has exceeded the fault threshold (p0605) or the timer (p0606) after the alarm threshold was
exceeded (p0604) has expired. The response parameterized in p0610 becomes active. The alarm is withdrawn if the
response threshold for wire breakage or sensor not connected is exceeded (R > 2120 Ohm).
PTC or bimetallic NC contact:
The response threshold of 1650 Ohm was exceeded or the NC contact opened and the timer (p0606) has expired.
The response parameterized in p0610 becomes active.
Possible causes:
- Motor is overloaded
- motor ambient temperature too high.
- Wire break or sensor not connected

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
KTY84:
The motor temperature has exceeded the fault threshold (p0605) or the timer (p0606) after the alarm threshold was
exceeded (p0604) has expired.
PTC, bimetallic NC contact:
The response threshold of 1650 Ohm was exceeded (for SME p4600 ... p4603 or for TM120 p4610 ... p4613 = 10,
30), or the timer (p0606) has expired after 1650 Ohm has been exceeded (for SME p4600 ... p4603 or for TM120
p4610 ... p4613 = 12, 32).
Motor temperature model:
The calculated motor temperature is too high.
Possible causes:
- motor overloaded.
- motor ambient temperature too high.
- PTC / bimetallic NC contact: Wire breakage or sensor not connected.
- Motor temperature model incorrectly parameterized.
F07011.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- Reduce the motor load.
- check the ambient temperature and the motor ventilation.
- check the wiring and the connection of the PTC or bimetallic NC contact.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- Reduce the motor load.
- check the ambient temperature and the motor ventilation.
- check the wiring and temperature sensor connection.
- check the monitoring limits (p5398, p5399).
- check the encoder type (p0404).
- check the motor type (p0300, p0301).
- check activation of the motor temperature model (p0612).
- check the motor temperature model parameters.
- check the encoder (p0404).

F07013.description: Drive: Motor temperature model configuration fault
F07013.cause: A fault has occurred in the configuration of the motor temperature model.
F07013.action:
- check the encoder type.
- check the motor type.
- check activation of the motor temperature model (p0612).
- check the parameters of the motor temperature model (p5350 and following).

F07016.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
An error was detected when evaluating the temperature sensor set in p0601.
Possible causes:
- wire breakage or sensor not connected (KTY: R > 2120 Ohm).
- measured resistance too low (PTC: R < 20 Ohm, KTY: R < 50 Ohm).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
An error was detected when evaluating the temperature sensor set in p0600 and p0601.
Possible causes:
- wire breakage or sensor not connected (KTY: R > 1630 Ohm).
- measured resistance too low (PTC: R < 20 Ohm, KTY: R < 50 Ohm).
F07016.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- make sure that the sensor is connected correctly.
- check the parameterization (p0601).
- induction motors: De-activate temperature sensor fault (p0607 = 0).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- make sure that the sensor is connected correctly.
- check the parameterization (p0600, p0601).
- induction motors: De-activate temperature sensor fault (p0607 = 0).
F07016.note:
If alarm A07015 is present, the time in p0607 is started. If the fault is still present after this time has expired, then
fault F07016 is output; however, at the earliest, 50 ms after alarm A07015.

F07080.cause: The closed-loop control parameters have been parameterized incorrectly (e.g. p0356 = L_spread = 0).
F07080.action: Modify the parameter indicated in the fault value (r0949) (e.g. p0640 = current limit > 0).

F07082.action:
- check the parameter involved.
- check the macro file and BICO interconnection.

F07083.cause: The ACX file (macro) to be executed was not able to be found in the appropriate directory.
F07083.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- check whether the file is saved in the appropriate directory on the memory card.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- check whether the file is saved in the appropriate directory on the memory card.
Example:
If p0015 is set to 1501, then the selected ACX file must be located in the following directory:
... /PMACROS/DEVICE/P15/PM001501.ACX

F07084.description: Macro: Condition for WaitUntil not fulfilled
F07084.cause: The WaitUntil condition set in the macro was not fulfilled in a certain number of attempts.
F07084.action: Check and correct the conditions for the WaitUntil loop.

F07085.cause:
Open-loop/closed-loop control parameters have had to be changed for the following reasons:
1. As a result of other parameters, they have exceeded the dynamic limits.
2. They cannot be used due to the fact that the hardware detected not having certain features.
F07085.action:
Not necessary.
It is not necessary to change the parameters as they have already been correctly limited.

F07086.description: Units changeover: Parameter limit violation due to reference value change
F07086.cause:
A reference parameter was changed in the system. This resulted in the fact that for the parameters involved, the
selected value was not able to be written in the per unit notation.
The values of the parameters were set to the corresponding violated minimum limit/maximum limit or to the factory
setting.
Possible causes:
- the steady-state minimum limit/maximum limit or that defined in the application was violated.
F07086.action: Check the adapted parameter value and if required correct.

F07087.description: Drive: Encoderless operation not possible for the selected pulse frequency
F07087.cause:
Encoderless operation is not possible for the selected pulse frequency (p1800).
Encoderless operation is activated under the following conditions:
- the changeover speed for encoderless operation (p1404) is less than the maximum speed (p0322).
- a control type with encoderless operation has been selected (p1300).
- encoder faults of the motor encoder result in a fault response with encoderless operation (p0491).
F07087.note:
In encoderless operation, the pulse frequency must be at least as high as half the current controller clock cycle
(1/p0115[0]).

F07088.description: Units changeover: Parameter limit violation due to units changeover
F07088.cause:
A changeover of units was initiated. This resulted in a violation of a parameter limit
Possible causes for the violation of a parameter limit:
- When rounding off a parameter corresponding to its decimal places, the steady-state minimum limit or maximum
limit was violated.
- inaccuracies for the data type "FloatingPoint".
In these cases, when the minimum limit is violated then the parameter value is rounded up and when the maximum
limited is violated the parameter value is rounded down.
F07088.action: Check the adapted parameter values and if required correct.

F07090.description: Drive: Upper torque limit less than the lower torque limit
F07090.cause: The upper torque limit is lower than the lower torque limit.
F07090.action: P1 must be >= P2 if parameter P1 is connected to p1522 and parameter P2 to p1523.

F07100.description: Drive: Sampling times cannot be reset
F07100.cause: When resetting drive parameter (p0976) sampling times cannot be reset using p0111, p0112, p0115.
F07100.action:
- continue to work with the set sampling times.
- before resetting the drive parameters, set the basic clock cycle p0110[0] to the original value.

F07110.description: Drive: Sampling times and basic clock cycle do not match
F07110.cause: The parameterized sampling times do not match the basic clock cycle.
F07110.action:
Enter the current controller sampling times so that they are identical to the basic clock cycle, e.g. by selecting p0112.
Note which basic clock cycle is selected in p0111.
The sampling times in p0115 can only be changed manually in the sampling times pre-setting "Expert" (p0112).

F07220.description: Drive: Master control by PLC missing
F07220.cause:
The "master control by PLC" signal was missing in operation.
- interconnection of the binector input for "master control by PLC" is incorrect (p0854).
- the higher-level control has withdrawn the "master control by PLC" signal.
- data transfer via the fieldbus (master/drive) was interrupted.
F07220.action:
- check the interconnection of the binector input for "master control by PLC" (p0854).
- check the "master control by PLC" signal and, if required, switch in.
- check the data transfer via the fieldbus (master/drive).
F07220.note: If the drive should continue to operate after withdrawing "master control by PLC" then fault response must be parameterized to NONE or the message type should be parameterized as alarm.

F07300.description: Drive: Line contactor feedback signal missing
F07300.cause:
- the line contactor was not able to be closed within the time in p0861.
- the line contactor was not able to be opened within the time in p0861.
- the line contactor dropped out during operation
- the line contactor has closed although the drive converter is powered down.
F07300.action:
- check the setting of p0860.
- check the feedback circuit from the line contactor.
- increase the monitoring time in p0861.

F07320.cause:
- The specified number of restart attempts (p1211) has been completely used up because within the monitoring time
(p1213) the faults were not able to be acknowledged. The number of restart attempts (p1211) is decremented at each
new start attempt.
- there is no active ON command.
- the monitoring time for the power unit has expired (p0857).
- when exiting commissioning or at the end of the motor identification routine or the speed controller optimization, the
drive unit is not automatically powered up again.
F07320.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- increase the number of restart attempts (p1211). The actual number of starting attempts is displayed in r1214.
- increase the delay time in p1212 and/or the monitoring time in p1213.
- issue an ON command (p0840).
- either increase or disable the monitoring time of the power unit (p0857).
- Reduce the delay time for resetting the start counter (p1213[1]) so that fewer faults are registered in the time interval.

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- increase the number of restart attempts (p1211). The actual number of starting attempts is displayed in r1214.
- increase the delay time in p1212 and/or the monitoring time in p1213.
- issue an ON command (p0840).
- either increase or disable the monitoring time of the power unit (p0857).

F07330.description: Flying restart: Measured search current too low
F07330.cause:
During a flying restart, it was identified that the search current reached is too low.
It is possible that the motor is not connected.

F07331.cause:
It is not possible to power up with the motor rotating (no flying restart). In the following cases, the "flying restart" function is not supported:
Perm.-magnet synch. motors (PEM): operation with U/f char. and sensorless vector control.

F07403.description: Drive: Lower DC link voltage threshold reached
F07403.cause:
The DC link voltage monitoring is active (p1240 = 5, 6) and the lower DC link voltage threshold (p1248) was reached
in the "Operation" state.
F07403.action:
- check the line supply voltage.
- check the infeed.
- reduce the lower DC link threshold (p1248).
- switch out (disable) the DC link voltage monitoring (p1240 = 0).

F07404.description: Drive: DC link voltage monitoring Vdc_Max / Drive: Upper DC link voltage threshold reached
F07404.cause:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
The monitoring of the DC link voltage p1284 has responded (only U/f control).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
The DC link voltage monitoring is active (p1240 = 4, 6) and the upper DC link voltage threshold (p1244) was reached
in the "Operation" state.
F07404.action:
[Drive object: CU250S_V, CU250S_V_CAN, CU250S_V_DP, CU250S_V_PN]
- check the line supply voltage.
- check the braking module.
- adapt the device supply voltage (p0210).
- adapt the DC link voltage monitoring (p1284).

[Drive object: CU250S_S, CU250S_S_CAN, CU250S_S_DP, CU250S_S_PN]
- check the line supply voltage.
- check the infeed module or the Braking Module.
- increase the upper DC link voltage threshold (p1244).
- switch out (disable) the DC link voltage monitoring (p1240 = 0).

F07405.description: Drive: Kinetic buffering minimum speed not reached
F07405.cause:
